construct_inventory.tested_construct: Age-associated changes in cognitive processing and retrieval without pathologic loss of stored semantic knowledge or functional independence
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the expected cognitive pattern of normal aging while avoiding the inference that independent daily function alone excludes mild cognitive impairment.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of CFTR-mediated epithelial chloride transport reduces water movement into airway secretions, producing dehydrated thick mucus.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain that CFTR loss reduces epithelial chloride and coupled water movement, dehydrating airway and ductal secretions; distinguish this transport defect from real mechanisms that cause impaired clearance, emphysema, or immunodeficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Re-emergent pulsatile hypothalamic GnRH signaling activates pituitary LH/FSH secretion and gonadal sex-steroid production at gonadarche.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish normal gonadarche—reactivation of pulsatile GnRH followed by LH/FSH and gonadal steroid secretion—from adrenarche, suppressive GnRH exposure, hyperprolactinemia, and gonadotropin-independent estrogen production.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Low-oxygen conditions promote hemoglobin S assembly into rigid intracellular strands, acutely deforming erythrocytes and promoting vaso-occlusion.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish deoxygenation-dependent HbS polymerization from alpha-globin underproduction, membrane-protein defects, oxidant injury, and impaired heme synthesis as mechanisms of red-cell disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: G6PD deficiency reduces pentose-phosphate-pathway NADPH production, leaving erythrocytes unable to withstand an oxidant challenge and causing Heinz-body injury, bite cells, and hemolysis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish G6PD-dependent NADPH failure and oxidant hemolysis from ATP depletion, membrane instability, beta-globin underproduction, and HbS polymerization.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Parvovirus B19 targets erythroid progenitor cells and can transiently arrest erythropoiesis; in an underlying chronic hemolytic disorder, the abrupt reticulocytopenia can cause a severe aplastic crisis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use an abrupt hemoglobin decline with reticulocytopenia to distinguish parvovirus B19 aplastic crisis from increased hemolysis and chronic causes of reduced erythropoiesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: VWF deficiency or dysfunction impairs primary hemostasis; repeated abnormalities in VWF antigen and platelet-dependent activity distinguish VWD from isolated coagulation-factor deficiencies.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish VWD from hemophilia A, ITP, DIC and factor XI deficiency by combining the bleeding phenotype with VWF-specific laboratory findings; do not exclude hemophilia on the basis of sex.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Congenital factor VIII deficiency causes hemophilia A; factor-specific testing distinguishes it from hemophilia B and VWF-related bleeding.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish hemophilia A from hemophilia B and other inherited bleeding disorders by combining the bleeding phenotype and mixing study with factor-specific and VWF assays.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Effective iron replacement restores iron-restricted erythropoiesis, so an early rise in reticulocytes precedes complete hemoglobin normalization.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use reticulocytosis as an early indicator of restored erythropoiesis after iron replacement.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Pancreatic enzymes release vitamin B12 from haptocorrin in the duodenum so that it can bind intrinsic factor for distal-ileal absorption.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Sequence the gastric, pancreatic and ileal steps of vitamin B12 absorption.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Defective phagocyte NADPH oxidase prevents an effective respiratory burst and superoxide generation, impairing intracellular killing of selected bacteria and fungi.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect an abnormal dihydrorhodamine oxidative-burst test with NADPH oxidase deficiency in chronic granulomatous disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: BTK deficiency arrests B-cell maturation at the pre-B-cell stage, causing markedly reduced mature B cells and all immunoglobulin classes after maternal IgG wanes.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the absent B cells and pan-hypogammaglobulinemia of X-linked agammaglobulinemia as a pre-B-cell maturation defect.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ADA deficiency causes accumulation of toxic purine metabolites, including deoxyadenosine-derived nucleotides, which are particularly toxic to developing lymphocytes and cause severe combined immunodeficiency.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate ADA deficiency to toxic purine-metabolite accumulation and combined T- and B-cell immunodeficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Three-gene alpha-globin deletion leads to excess beta-chain tetramerization into hemoglobin H after infancy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify hemoglobin H as beta4 tetramers formed in three-gene alpha-thalassemia after the fetal-to-adult globin transition.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Immune-mediated central nervous system demyelination produces neurologic deficits separated in time and space, often including optic neuritis, sensory symptoms, and upper motor neuron findings.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize multiple sclerosis from dissemination of central nervous system deficits in time and space.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Degeneration of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra pars compacta reduces striatal dopamine, decreasing direct-pathway activity and increasing indirect-pathway influence on movement.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link parkinsonian motor findings to loss of substantia nigra pars compacta dopaminergic neurons.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Expansion of a CAG trinucleotide repeat in HTT produces a toxic polyglutamine-expanded huntingtin protein and autosomal dominant neurodegeneration with anticipation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize trinucleotide-repeat anticipation in Huntington disease as expansion of the HTT CAG repeat.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Pyridostigmine inhibits acetylcholinesterase and slows acetylcholine breakdown, increasing transmitter availability at the neuromuscular junction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the symptomatic benefit of pyridostigmine in myasthenia gravis through acetylcholinesterase inhibition.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Botulinum neurotoxin blocks presynaptic acetylcholine release at peripheral cholinergic synapses, producing cranial neuropathies followed by symmetric descending flaccid paralysis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize foodborne botulism from cranial nerve dysfunction and descending paralysis after ingestion of improperly preserved food.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Guillain–Barré syndrome can rapidly weaken respiratory muscles; serial forced vital capacity detects declining ventilatory function before overt respiratory failure.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Monitor evolving Guillain–Barré syndrome with serial respiratory mechanics rather than waiting for hypoxemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Layer II neurons of the entorhinal cortex, which provide major perforant-path input to the hippocampus, show marked loss even in very mild Alzheimer disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize early Alzheimer-related neuronal loss to layer II of the entorhinal cortex and connect it to episodic-memory dysfunction.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Focal seizures arise from abnormal synchronized neuronal activity in a localized cortical network; temporal lobe seizures can produce stereotyped experiential auras and impaired awareness.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize focal impaired-awareness seizures with experiential aura and automatisms to the temporal lobe.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduced aqueous humor outflow through the trabecular meshwork chronically elevates intraocular pressure and damages retinal ganglion-cell axons at the optic nerve head.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate chronic open-angle glaucoma to impaired trabecular aqueous humor outflow and optic nerve cupping.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Separation of the neurosensory retina from the underlying retinal pigment epithelium causes photopsias, new floaters, and a curtain-like visual-field defect.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize retinal detachment from sudden flashes, floaters, and a curtain-like visual-field loss.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of the NF2 tumor suppressor merlin permits excessive proliferation of Schwann and other nervous-system support cells, predisposing especially to bilateral vestibular schwannomas.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate bilateral vestibular schwannomas with loss of the NF2-encoded tumor suppressor merlin.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: GAA-repeat expansion in FXN reduces frataxin, impairing mitochondrial iron handling and oxidative metabolism and causing progressive neurologic and cardiac injury.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect Friedreich ataxia to frataxin deficiency and mitochondrial dysfunction.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of functional dystrophin destabilizes the sarcolemma during contraction, causing repeated muscle-fiber injury, necrosis, and progressive replacement by fat and connective tissue.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect Gowers sign, calf pseudohypertrophy, and high creatine kinase with loss of dystrophin in Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: FBN1 loss disrupts fibrillin-1 microfibrils and dysregulates transforming growth factor-beta signaling, weakening elastic connective tissues including the ascending aorta.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate the skeletal, ocular, and aortic manifestations of Marfan syndrome with fibrillin-1 deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Quantitative or structural defects in type I collagen weaken bone matrix and can also affect sclerae, dentin, and hearing structures.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize osteogenesis imperfecta from bone fragility plus extra-skeletal manifestations of type I collagen disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Type V collagen defects impair collagen fibril organization, producing hyperextensible fragile skin, widened atrophic scars, easy bruising, and generalized joint hypermobility.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect the classical Ehlers-Danlos phenotype with type V collagen gene defects.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Supersaturation of urate leads to deposition of monosodium urate crystals in joints, triggering a neutrophil-rich inflammatory response.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Diagnose gout by its classic joint distribution and monosodium urate crystal morphology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoimmune synovial inflammation produces pannus formation, cartilage destruction, and marginal bone erosions, typically in a symmetric small-joint distribution.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the characteristic distribution and inflammatory stiffness pattern of rheumatoid arthritis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Immune activation involving dendritic cells and the IL-23/Th17 axis promotes keratinocyte hyperproliferation and inflammatory plaque formation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain psoriatic plaque formation through immune-driven keratinocyte hyperproliferation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Defects in basal keratin proteins such as keratin 5 or keratin 14 weaken the basal keratinocyte cytoskeleton, causing intraepidermal blistering after minor mechanical trauma.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect KRT14 defects with failure of basal keratinocyte intermediate filaments and mechanically induced blistering.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Gain-of-function FGFR3 signaling inhibits chondrocyte proliferation and endochondral ossification, disproportionately limiting growth of long bones.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain disproportionate short stature in achondroplasia as gain-of-function FGFR3 signaling that suppresses endochondral ossification.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of PTCH1 removes inhibition of Smoothened and constitutively activates Hedgehog signaling, promoting basal cell carcinoma development.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect PTCH1 loss in basal cell nevus syndrome with derepressed Smoothened and Hedgehog signaling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acute coronary plaque disruption with superimposed thrombosis abruptly reduces myocardial blood flow, producing ischemic myocyte necrosis and release of cardiac troponin.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Diagnose acute STEMI from prolonged ischemic symptoms, territorial ST elevation, and myocardial-injury biomarkers.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Endothelial dysfunction permits LDL entry and modification in the arterial intima; macrophages ingest modified lipoproteins through scavenger receptors and become foam cells, initiating fatty streaks.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain foam-cell formation in atherosclerosis as macrophage uptake of modified LDL in the arterial intima.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autosomal dominant pathogenic variants in sarcomeric proteins such as beta-myosin heavy chain cause myocyte hypertrophy and disarray, often producing asymmetric septal hypertrophy and dynamic outflow obstruction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate familial hypertrophic cardiomyopathy with pathogenic variants in cardiac sarcomere proteins.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss-of-function KCNH2 variants reduce the rapid delayed-rectifier potassium current, delaying ventricular repolarization and predisposing to torsades de pointes.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect KCNH2 loss of function with reduced cardiac potassium current and delayed ventricular repolarization.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduced cardiac output activates sympathetic signaling and the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system, increasing vasoconstriction and sodium-water retention but chronically worsening remodeling and congestion.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain RAAS activation in systolic heart failure as a response to reduced effective renal perfusion.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Predict net left-to-right shunting through a large nonrestrictive VSD from relative pulmonary and systemic vascular resistance, despite similar ventricular systolic pressures.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict net left-to-right shunting through a large nonrestrictive VSD from relative pulmonary and systemic vascular resistance, despite similar ventricular systolic pressures.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Inflammation of the pericardium produces pleuritic positional chest pain and diffuse epicardial electrical injury, classically causing widespread ST elevation and PR-segment depression.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Diagnose acute pericarditis from its characteristic chest-pain quality and diffuse ECG pattern.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Congenital narrowing of the aortic arch or proximal descending aorta raises proximal arterial pressure while reducing lower-extremity perfusion and can produce collateral intercostal flow.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize coarctation of the aorta from differential upper- and lower-extremity blood pressure and delayed femoral pulses.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of functional hepatic LDL receptors reduces receptor-mediated endocytosis and plasma clearance of LDL particles, producing markedly elevated LDL cholesterol and premature atherosclerosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain severe LDL elevation in familial hypercholesterolemia through impaired hepatic LDL receptor-mediated endocytosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Airway inflammation and hyperresponsiveness produce reversible bronchoconstriction, mucosal edema, and mucus secretion, increasing airway resistance especially during expiration.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain reversible airflow limitation in asthma through increased airway resistance from bronchoconstriction.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of alpha-1 antitrypsin leaves neutrophil elastase insufficiently inhibited, allowing proteolytic destruction of alveolar elastic tissue and early emphysema.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency emphysema to unopposed neutrophil elastase activity.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Diffuse inflammatory injury to the alveolar-capillary barrier increases permeability, causing protein-rich pulmonary edema, loss of aerated lung, and severe shunt physiology.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain noncardiogenic edema in ARDS through inflammatory disruption of the alveolar-capillary barrier.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Embolic obstruction of pulmonary arterial flow creates regions that are ventilated but underperfused, increasing physiologic dead space and causing acute V/Q mismatch.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Diagnose acute pulmonary embolism from abrupt respiratory symptoms plus major venous thromboembolism risk factors.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Glomerular filtration barrier injury causes heavy proteinuria, leading to hypoalbuminemia, reduced plasma oncotic pressure, edema, and compensatory hepatic lipoprotein production.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize nephrotic syndrome from massive protein loss and its systemic consequences.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Mesangial deposition of IgA-containing immune complexes triggers glomerular inflammation and recurrent hematuria, often temporally linked to mucosal infections.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Diagnose IgA nephropathy from synpharyngitic glomerular hematuria and urinary red-cell casts.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Pathogenic PKD1 or PKD2 variants disrupt polycystin-dependent tubular signaling; somatic second-hit events in individual tubular cells can promote focal cyst formation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply a somatic second-hit model to focal cyst formation in autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Indomethacin reduces cyclooxygenase-dependent prostaglandin E2 excess in Bartter syndrome, decreasing renal salt and water loss.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate NSAID therapy in Bartter syndrome to suppression of excessive renal prostaglandin E2 synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Defective proximal tubular and intestinal transport of cystine and dibasic amino acids increases urinary cystine concentration and promotes recurrent cystine stones.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the COLA amino-acid transport defect underlying cystinuria and hexagonal stones.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: AGXT deficiency reduces peroxisomal conversion of glyoxylate to glycine, diverting glyoxylate toward oxalate production and causing recurrent calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis and systemic oxalosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain primary hyperoxaluria type 1 through failed peroxisomal conversion of glyoxylate to glycine.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: COL4A5 defects disrupt type IV collagen in glomerular basement membrane, cochlea, and ocular structures, causing progressive hematuric kidney disease with sensorineural hearing loss.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect hematuric nephropathy plus hearing loss with type IV collagen defects in Alport syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of AVPR2 signaling prevents vasopressin-induced cAMP generation in collecting-duct principal cells, reducing aquaporin-2 insertion and impairing urinary concentration.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain nephrogenic diabetes insipidus through failed V2-receptor signaling and aquaporin-2 membrane insertion.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ATP7B loss impairs biliary copper excretion and copper incorporation into ceruloplasmin, causing toxic copper accumulation in liver, brain, and cornea.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain Wilson disease through defective ATP7B-mediated biliary copper excretion.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: HFE-related dysregulation lowers hepcidin signaling and inappropriately increases intestinal iron absorption and iron release, causing progressive parenchymal iron overload.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect HFE-related hemochromatosis with excessive intestinal iron absorption and systemic iron overload.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: An immune response to dietary gluten in genetically susceptible patients injures small-intestinal mucosa, causing villous atrophy, crypt hyperplasia, and malabsorption.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Diagnose celiac disease from malabsorptive symptoms plus characteristic serologic evidence.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chronic transmural inflammatory bowel disease produces skip lesions, fistulas, strictures, and can involve any part of the gastrointestinal tract, commonly the terminal ileum.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Crohn disease from ulcerative colitis using transmural fistulizing disease and skip lesions.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduced UGT1A1 activity mildly impairs hepatic bilirubin glucuronidation, producing intermittent isolated unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia that can worsen with fasting or illness.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain benign fasting-associated unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia in Gilbert syndrome through reduced UGT1A1 activity.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Aldolase B deficiency prevents cleavage of fructose-1-phosphate, trapping phosphate and inhibiting hepatic glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis after fructose ingestion.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate fructose-triggered hypoglycemia and liver dysfunction to aldolase B deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Certain misfolded alpha-1 antitrypsin variants polymerize and accumulate within hepatocyte endoplasmic reticulum, causing toxic gain-of-function liver injury.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish the toxic protein-accumulation mechanism of alpha-1 antitrypsin liver disease from the loss-of-antiprotease mechanism causing emphysema.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Gain-of-function PRSS1 variants increase inappropriate intrapancreatic trypsin activity, promoting premature digestive-enzyme activation, recurrent pancreatic autodigestion, and chronic pancreatitis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain hereditary pancreatitis through inappropriate intrapancreatic trypsin activation caused by PRSS1 variants.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoimmune T-cell-mediated destruction of pancreatic beta cells causes absolute insulin deficiency and low endogenous C-peptide production.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect low C-peptide and islet autoimmunity with beta-cell destruction in type 1 diabetes.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: TSH-receptor-stimulating autoantibodies activate thyroid follicular cells, causing diffuse thyroid hyperfunction and sometimes autoimmune orbitopathy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Diagnose Graves disease from diffuse autoimmune hyperthyroidism with orbitopathy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoimmune lymphocytic destruction of thyroid tissue with thyroid autoantibodies gradually reduces thyroid hormone production, producing primary hypothyroidism.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Hashimoto thyroiditis from autoimmune primary hypothyroidism and anti-thyroid peroxidase antibodies.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Primary adrenal cortical failure lowers cortisol and often aldosterone; loss of cortisol negative feedback raises ACTH, and mineralocorticoid deficiency causes sodium loss and potassium retention.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate primary adrenal insufficiency from secondary adrenal disease using mineralocorticoid status and ACTH-related hyperpigmentation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: An ACTH-secreting pituitary corticotroph adenoma chronically stimulates the adrenal cortex to produce excess cortisol.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish Cushing disease from other causes of Cushing syndrome by identifying pituitary ACTH excess as the initiating lesion.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Excess PTH increases bone resorption and renal calcium retention while reducing proximal tubular phosphate reabsorption and increasing calcitriol production.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain hypophosphatemia in hyperparathyroidism through PTH-mediated phosphaturia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: CYP21A2 deficiency blocks cortisol and often aldosterone synthesis, increasing ACTH and shunting steroid precursors toward adrenal androgen production.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify 21-hydroxylase deficiency from salt-wasting adrenal insufficiency plus androgen excess.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Complete or partial monosomy X causes ovarian dysgenesis, short stature, and characteristic cardiovascular and lymphatic developmental abnormalities.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate short stature, gonadal dysgenesis, and coarctation with monosomy X.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: An extra X chromosome in a male causes seminiferous tubule dysgenesis, testicular failure, elevated gonadotropins, infertility, and variable gynecomastia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Klinefelter syndrome and its characteristic 47,XXY karyotype.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Ovarian hyperandrogenism and disordered follicular maturation produce chronic anovulation; insulin resistance can amplify androgen production and lower sex hormone-binding globulin.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain oligomenorrhea in PCOS through chronic anovulation associated with hyperandrogenism and insulin resistance.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Hypothalamic dopamine tonically inhibits prolactin secretion through D2 receptors; loss of dopaminergic restraint or autonomous lactotroph secretion raises prolactin and suppresses GnRH.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recall dopaminergic inhibition of prolactin secretion and its physiologic role in hyperprolactinemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Germline activating RET variants constitutively stimulate a receptor tyrosine kinase, predisposing to medullary thyroid carcinoma and pheochromocytoma.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate medullary thyroid carcinoma plus pheochromocytoma with activating RET mutations in MEN2.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss-of-function androgen receptor variants prevent cellular responses to testosterone and dihydrotestosterone in an XY individual despite normal anti-Müllerian hormone production.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the phenotype of complete androgen insensitivity syndrome using androgen receptor failure with preserved anti-Müllerian hormone action.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Phenylalanine hydroxylase deficiency impairs conversion of phenylalanine to tyrosine, causing phenylalanine accumulation and reduced tyrosine availability.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the blocked biochemical reaction in classic phenylketonuria.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: GALT deficiency blocks conversion of galactose-1-phosphate with UDP-glucose, causing toxic galactose-1-phosphate accumulation after lactose-containing feeds.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify GALT deficiency in a neonate who becomes ill after lactose exposure.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Deficiency of branched-chain alpha-ketoacid dehydrogenase prevents oxidative decarboxylation of leucine, isoleucine, and valine metabolites, causing neurotoxic accumulation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate neonatal encephalopathy with sweet-smelling urine to failure of branched-chain amino acid catabolism.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Hexosaminidase A deficiency causes neuronal GM2 ganglioside accumulation and progressive neurodegeneration without the hepatosplenomegaly typical of several other lysosomal storage disorders.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Tay-Sachs from other lysosomal storage disorders using neurologic and visceral findings.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Glucocerebrosidase deficiency causes glucocerebroside accumulation within macrophage lysosomes, producing hepatosplenomegaly, cytopenias, and bone disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Gaucher disease from macrophage lipid storage with visceral and skeletal involvement.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Alpha-galactosidase A deficiency causes lysosomal globotriaosylceramide accumulation in vascular endothelium and multiple organs, producing neuropathic pain, angiokeratomas, renal disease, and cardiomyopathy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the stored substrate in X-linked Fabry disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ABCD1 deficiency impairs transport of very-long-chain fatty acids into peroxisomes for beta-oxidation, causing VLCFA accumulation and injury to cerebral myelin and adrenal cortex.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect elevated very-long-chain fatty acids in X-ALD with defective peroxisomal transport and oxidation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Pathogenic mitochondrial DNA variants are typically maternally inherited because the embryo's mitochondria derive predominantly from the oocyte; heteroplasmy contributes to variable expression among relatives.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize maternal inheritance as the defining transmission pattern of mitochondrial DNA variants.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Germline TP53 loss compromises p53-mediated DNA-damage checkpoints, apoptosis, and senescence, allowing genetically damaged cells to survive and predisposing to diverse early cancers.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect a broad spectrum of very early cancers with germline TP53 loss in Li-Fraumeni syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Defective nucleotide excision repair prevents removal of bulky ultraviolet-induced DNA lesions such as pyrimidine dimers, causing extreme photosensitivity and early skin cancers.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate severe UV sensitivity and early skin cancer to defective nucleotide excision repair.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Sensitivity is the proportion of people with the disease who test positive: true positives divided by all people who truly have disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Calculate and interpret sensitivity from a 2×2 diagnostic-test table.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Specificity is the proportion of people without the disease who test negative: true negatives divided by all people who truly do not have disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Calculate specificity from disease-free subjects in a diagnostic-test validation study.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: For a test with unchanged sensitivity and specificity, positive predictive value decreases as disease prevalence falls because a larger fraction of positive results are false positives.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict the effect of disease prevalence on positive predictive value.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Risk ratio compares cumulative incidence in an exposed group with cumulative incidence in an unexposed group.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Calculate a risk ratio from cohort incidence proportions.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: In a case-control study the exposure odds ratio is calculated by the cross-product ad/bc and is the standard measure of exposure-disease association because disease risks cannot usually be directly calculated.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Calculate and interpret an odds ratio from a case-control 2×2 table.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Qualified interpretation improves accurate bidirectional communication and protects patient understanding and autonomy when clinician and patient do not share a language.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Choose qualified language assistance rather than relying on family members for complex medical communication.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Teach-back evaluates whether the clinician explained information clearly by asking the patient to describe the plan in their own words, allowing misunderstanding to be identified and corrected.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use teach-back to verify patient understanding without shaming or testing the patient.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Patient-centered adverse-event disclosure promptly communicates known facts, acknowledges harm with empathy, avoids unsupported speculation, explains current care and investigation, and maintains follow-up communication.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Communicate transparently and empathetically after a confirmed patient-safety event while avoiding speculation.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: When a capable patient is present, clinicians may share information directly relevant to a family member's involvement in care if the patient agrees, does not object after an opportunity to do so, or circumstances reasonably support that inference.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply HIPAA rules to communication with family members involved in a capable patient's care.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Valid informed consent is an ongoing communication process requiring adequate disclosure, facilitation of understanding, and a voluntary decision rather than merely obtaining a signature.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish genuine informed consent from mere documentation of consent.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: When a child is capable of assent and assent is required by the IRB, assent means affirmative agreement; silence or failure to resist is not sufficient.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply the federal definition of child assent as affirmative agreement rather than passive nonobjection.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Shared decision making combines evidence about reasonable options with clinician expertise and the informed patient's values and preferences to reach and revisit a treatment decision.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use patient values and evidence about reasonable options to conduct shared decision making.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Adequate folate before conception and during early pregnancy lowers the risk of neural tube closure defects that arise in the first month of development.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify folic acid as the key preventive nutrient for neural tube defects.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The fetal ductus arteriosus shunts blood from pulmonary artery to aorta; after birth rising oxygen tension and falling prostaglandins promote closure.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the ductus arteriosus from its fetal circulatory connection and postnatal PDA findings.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoantibodies target platelet antigens, accelerating splenic platelet clearance and causing isolated thrombocytopenia with mucocutaneous bleeding.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize immune thrombocytopenia from isolated platelet loss and mucocutaneous bleeding.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Severely reduced ADAMTS13 activity, often from an acquired inhibitor, permits ultra-large von Willebrand factor multimers to persist and drive platelet-rich microthrombi in thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link TTP to severe ADAMTS13 deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Systemic coagulation activation generates diffuse microthrombi while consuming platelets and clotting factors, producing simultaneous thrombosis and bleeding.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize disseminated intravascular coagulation from systemic consumption of platelets and clotting factors.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Factor V Leiden is resistant to inactivation by activated protein C, prolonging procoagulant factor V activity and increasing venous thrombosis risk.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain factor V Leiden thrombophilia through activated protein C resistance.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Activated protein C normally limits coagulation by inactivating factors Va and VIIIa; deficiency therefore increases venous thrombosis risk.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the anticoagulant targets of activated protein C.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: An acquired PIGA mutation prevents GPI-anchor synthesis, causing loss of complement-regulatory proteins such as CD55 and CD59 and intravascular hemolysis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain PNH through acquired PIGA mutation and loss of GPI-anchored complement regulators.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Failure or immune destruction of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells causes hypocellular marrow and pancytopenia without marrow infiltration.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize aplastic anemia from pancytopenia and hypocellular bone marrow.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Folate deficiency impairs one-carbon transfer reactions needed for nucleotide synthesis, causing defective DNA replication and megaloblastic hematopoiesis without the neurologic injury typical of vitamin B12 deficiency.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain folate-deficiency macrocytosis through defective DNA synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The PML-RARA fusion from t(15;17) blocks myeloid differentiation at the promyelocyte stage and is specifically targetable with differentiation therapy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate APL morphology and DIC with the PML-RARA fusion.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The BCR-ABL1 fusion encodes a constitutively active tyrosine kinase that drives uncontrolled myeloid proliferation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect the Philadelphia chromosome with BCR-ABL1 tyrosine kinase activity in CML.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Deficiency of C5 through C9 impairs membrane attack complex formation and markedly increases susceptibility to recurrent invasive Neisseria infections.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate recurrent invasive Neisseria infection with terminal complement deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Progressive degeneration of upper and lower motor neurons causes mixed spasticity, weakness, fasciculations, and muscle atrophy while sensation remains relatively preserved.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize ALS from progressive mixed upper and lower motor neuron signs.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoantibodies against presynaptic voltage-gated calcium channels reduce acetylcholine release; repeated activity can transiently improve strength by increasing presynaptic calcium.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Lambert-Eaton from myasthenia by presynaptic calcium-channel autoimmunity and facilitation.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Spinal cord hemisection damages ipsilateral corticospinal and dorsal column tracts below the lesion while interrupting crossed spinothalamic fibers, producing contralateral pain and temperature loss.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize Brown-Sequard syndrome using spinal tract crossing patterns.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Thiamine deficiency impairs thiamine-dependent oxidative metabolism in vulnerable brain regions, producing confusion, ocular motor abnormalities, and gait ataxia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Wernicke encephalopathy from the classic thiamine-deficiency neurologic triad.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Rupture of an intracranial aneurysm releases arterial blood into the subarachnoid space, causing abrupt meningeal irritation and a thunderclap headache.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage from a thunderclap headache and meningismus.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Temporal bone fracture can tear the middle meningeal artery, causing arterial blood to collect between skull and dura in a lens-shaped hematoma.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the middle meningeal artery as the typical source of traumatic epidural hematoma.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acceleration-deceleration tears cortical bridging veins, allowing venous blood to collect between dura and arachnoid, especially in older adults with cerebral atrophy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify bridging-vein injury as the source of subdural hematoma.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acute peripheral facial nerve dysfunction causes ipsilateral weakness of both upper and lower facial muscles because the lesion is distal to bilateral corticobulbar input to the forehead.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate peripheral facial palsy from cortical facial weakness using forehead involvement.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Abnormal inner-ear fluid homeostasis produces episodic vertigo, fluctuating sensorineural hearing loss, tinnitus, and aural fullness.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Meniere disease from its characteristic vestibular and auditory symptom cluster.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Interruption of sympathetic innervation to the eye causes ipsilateral miosis, mild ptosis, and anhidrosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize ptosis, miosis, and anhidrosis to sympathetic pathway injury.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Hemiballismus is a hyperkinetic movement disorder characterized by sudden, violent, high-amplitude flinging movements affecting one side of the body and commonly reflects contralateral basal-ganglia dysfunction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize hemiballismus from unilateral violent high-amplitude flinging movements.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Dominant inferior frontal cortex injury impairs language production while relatively preserving comprehension, often with contralateral face-arm weakness from nearby motor cortex involvement.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize nonfluent aphasia to the dominant inferior frontal gyrus.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Estrogen deficiency increases osteoclast-mediated bone resorption, producing loss of trabecular and cortical bone mass while mineralization remains normal.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain postmenopausal osteoporosis through increased bone resorption.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Vitamin D deficiency reduces intestinal calcium and phosphate absorption, impairing mineralization of growing bone and widening growth plates.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize nutritional rickets from impaired bone mineralization during growth.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Immune-mediated vascular injury and fibroblast activation lead to excessive collagen deposition in skin and internal organs.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize systemic sclerosis from vascular, cutaneous, and gastrointestinal fibrosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Immune-mediated inflammatory injury of skeletal muscle and skin causes symmetric proximal muscle weakness with characteristic heliotrope and Gottron lesions.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize dermatomyositis from proximal weakness and characteristic rash.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: IgG autoantibodies against desmoglein disrupt keratinocyte adhesion within the epidermis, causing flaccid bullae and mucosal erosions.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link flaccid mucocutaneous bullae to desmosomal autoantibodies.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoantibodies against hemidesmosomal proteins at the dermal-epidermal junction cause subepidermal blister formation and tense bullae.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate bullous pemphigoid from pemphigus by blister level and target structure.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Malignant transformation of melanocytes produces an asymmetric evolving pigmented lesion with irregular borders and color variation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize melanoma using classic ABCDE warning features.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Calcium pyrophosphate crystals deposit in cartilage and synovium, triggering acute neutrophilic inflammation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish pseudogout from gout by crystal morphology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Bacteremia can seed metaphyseal bone, where sluggish blood flow favors microbial deposition and inflammatory bone destruction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize acute hematogenous osteomyelitis in a child.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Malignant osteoblasts produce osteoid, commonly arising in metaphyses of long bones in adolescents.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize osteosarcoma from age, location, and radiographic pattern.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Fixed left ventricular outflow obstruction causes pressure overload, concentric hypertrophy, exertional syncope, angina, and heart failure.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Diagnose aortic stenosis from classic symptoms and murmur.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Papillary muscle rupture after myocardial infarction causes abrupt loss of mitral leaflet support, severe regurgitation, and pulmonary edema.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify papillary muscle rupture as a post-MI cause of acute mitral regurgitation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Diastolic backflow from aorta to left ventricle causes volume overload, increased stroke volume, widened pulse pressure, and eccentric ventricular dilation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict eccentric hypertrophy in chronic aortic regurgitation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chaotic atrial electrical activity eliminates coordinated atrial contraction and produces an irregularly irregular ventricular response.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize atrial fibrillation on ECG.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: An accessory atrioventricular pathway bypasses the AV node, causing ventricular pre-excitation with short PR interval and delta wave and enabling reentrant tachycardia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect short PR and delta wave with an accessory AV pathway.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Severe pump failure lowers cardiac output and arterial pressure while increasing ventricular filling pressures and systemic vascular resistance through compensatory vasoconstriction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict cardiogenic shock hemodynamics.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: An intimal tear permits blood to enter the aortic media and create a false lumen, producing abrupt tearing pain and pulse or pressure asymmetry.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize aortic dissection from its characteristic pain and vascular findings.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Rapid pericardial fluid accumulation raises intrapericardial pressure, restricts diastolic filling, equalizes chamber pressures, and lowers stroke volume.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain tamponade hypotension through impaired diastolic filling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Anterior malalignment of the infundibular septum causes right ventricular outflow obstruction, ventricular septal defect, overriding aorta, and right ventricular hypertrophy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate TOF anatomy to infundibular septal malalignment.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chronic exposure to inhaled toxins causes airway inflammation and/or emphysematous destruction, producing persistent expiratory airflow limitation that is not fully reversible.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize COPD from exposure history and fixed obstructive spirometry.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Progressive interstitial fibrosis stiffens the lungs, reducing compliance and diffusion capacity and producing a restrictive ventilatory defect.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis from chronic restrictive symptoms and characteristic CT findings.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Destruction of alveolar septa reduces alveolar-capillary surface area, lowering diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect alveolar septal destruction in emphysema with reduced DLCO.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acute hypoventilation raises arterial carbon dioxide, shifting the bicarbonate buffer equilibrium toward carbonic acid and lowering pH.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify acute respiratory acidosis from blood gas data.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Immune complexes formed after nephritogenic streptococcal infection deposit in glomeruli, activate complement, and cause acute nephritic syndrome.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate PSGN from IgA nephropathy using timing and complement levels.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoantibodies against alpha-3 chains of type IV collagen in glomerular and alveolar basement membranes cause rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis and pulmonary hemorrhage.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify type IV collagen as the autoantigen in anti-GBM disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Generalized proximal tubular dysfunction causes urinary wasting of bicarbonate, phosphate, glucose, amino acids, and uric acid.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize Fanconi syndrome to the proximal tubule.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of the thiazide-sensitive Na-Cl cotransporter in the distal convoluted tubule causes salt wasting, hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis, hypomagnesemia, and hypocalciuria.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Gitelman from Bartter syndrome using transporter location and urinary calcium.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Elevated extracellular potassium partially depolarizes cardiac myocytes, alters sodium-channel availability, and produces progressive ECG changes including peaked T waves and QRS widening.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize hyperkalemia from classic ECG changes.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduced perfusion pressure in a stenotic renal artery stimulates renin release, increasing angiotensin II and aldosterone and causing secondary hypertension.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain renovascular hypertension through renal hypoperfusion and renin release.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Malignant renal tubular epithelial cells can produce hematuria, flank mass or pain, and paraneoplastic hormones such as erythropoietin.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize RCC and its erythropoietin-associated paraneoplastic effect.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Ascending bacterial infection of the renal pelvis and parenchyma produces fever, flank pain, pyuria, and often white-cell casts.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate pyelonephritis from lower urinary infection.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Dihydrotestosterone-driven stromal and glandular hyperplasia in the periurethral transition zone narrows the prostatic urethra and causes bladder outlet obstruction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect BPH pathophysiology with DHT signaling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: H pylori colonizes gastric mucus using urease, alters mucosal defense and gastrin signaling, and promotes chronic inflammation leading to peptic ulcer disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify urease as a key H pylori virulence factor.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Premature intrapancreatic activation of digestive enzymes causes pancreatic autodigestion, inflammation, and elevated serum lipase.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize gallstone-associated acute pancreatitis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Persistent cystic duct obstruction by a gallstone causes gallbladder distention and inflammation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate acute cholecystitis from biliary colic.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of inhibitory myenteric neurons reduces nitric oxide-mediated lower esophageal sphincter relaxation and causes aperistalsis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain achalasia through loss of inhibitory myenteric neurotransmission.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Germline APC loss impairs beta-catenin degradation, activating Wnt signaling and producing hundreds to thousands of colorectal adenomas with near-certain cancer risk without intervention.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect FAP with APC loss and increased beta-catenin signaling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Inherited mismatch-repair gene defects cause microsatellite instability and rapid accumulation of replication errors, predisposing to colorectal and endometrial cancers.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate microsatellite instability with mismatch-repair deficiency in Lynch syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Continuous mucosal inflammation begins in the rectum and extends proximally through the colon, causing bloody diarrhea and increased colorectal cancer risk.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate ulcerative colitis from Crohn disease by distribution and depth.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: After recovery from natural HBV infection, HBsAg disappears while anti-HBs and anti-HBc IgG remain detectable.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Interpret hepatitis B serology patterns.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Growth hormone excess after epiphyseal closure raises IGF-1 and causes soft-tissue and acral overgrowth, insulin resistance, and organ enlargement.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize acromegaly from characteristic adult GH excess.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Deficient vasopressin secretion prevents collecting-duct water reabsorption; exogenous desmopressin restores urine concentrating ability.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate central from nephrogenic diabetes insipidus by desmopressin response.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Medullary thyroid carcinoma arises from parafollicular C cells and secretes calcitonin; hereditary forms are associated with RET activation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the cellular origin of medullary thyroid carcinoma.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autonomous aldosterone excess increases distal sodium reabsorption and potassium/hydrogen secretion, causing hypertension, hypokalemia, metabolic alkalosis, and suppressed renin.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize primary hyperaldosteronism from renin-aldosterone physiology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Catecholamine-secreting chromaffin-cell tumors cause episodic adrenergic surges with headache, sweating, palpitations, and hypertension.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize pheochromocytoma from episodic catecholamine symptoms.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PTH deficiency lowers renal calcium reabsorption and calcitriol activation while increasing phosphate retention, causing hypocalcemia and hyperphosphatemia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize hypoparathyroidism after neck surgery.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Absolute insulin deficiency plus counterregulatory hormones accelerates lipolysis and hepatic ketogenesis, producing high-anion-gap metabolic acidosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain DKA through increased lipolysis and ketone production.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Implantation outside the uterine cavity, most often in a fallopian tube, can cause unilateral pelvic pain and life-threatening intra-abdominal bleeding if rupture occurs.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize ectopic pregnancy from early-pregnancy pain and ultrasound findings.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Abnormal placentation and maternal endothelial dysfunction after 20 weeks cause hypertension with proteinuria or systemic organ injury.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize preeclampsia with severe features from new hypertension after 20 weeks, proteinuria, severe-range blood pressure, and neurologic symptoms.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Failure of testicular descent leaves the testis outside the scrotum, increasing risks of impaired spermatogenesis and testicular malignancy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize major long-term complications of cryptorchidism.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Ovarian follicular depletion lowers estrogen and inhibin production, removing negative feedback and increasing pituitary FSH and LH, especially FSH.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict postmenopausal hormone changes.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: BRCA1 participates in homologous recombination repair of DNA double-strand breaks; germline loss increases breast and ovarian cancer susceptibility.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect BRCA1 cancer susceptibility with homologous recombination deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Germ cell malignancies commonly present as painless testicular masses in young men and are associated with cryptorchidism as a risk factor.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the classic presentation of a testicular germ cell tumor.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MCAD deficiency impairs mitochondrial beta-oxidation of medium-chain fatty acids, causing fasting intolerance, hypoketotic hypoglycemia, and dicarboxylic acid accumulation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize hypoketotic fasting hypoglycemia as a fatty acid oxidation defect.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Glucose-6-phosphatase deficiency blocks the final step of glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis, causing severe fasting hypoglycemia, lactic acidosis, hyperuricemia, and hepatomegaly.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the blocked reaction in von Gierke disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: HGPRT deficiency blocks salvage of hypoxanthine and guanine, increasing de novo purine synthesis and uric acid production while causing severe neurologic and behavioral abnormalities.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect self-injury and hyperuricemia to defective purine salvage.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cystathionine beta-synthase deficiency impairs conversion of homocysteine to cystathionine, causing homocysteine accumulation, thrombosis, osteoporosis, and ectopia lentis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the blocked transsulfuration reaction in homocystinuria.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Homogentisate 1,2-dioxygenase deficiency causes homogentisic acid accumulation, darkening urine and depositing ochronotic pigment in cartilage.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the stored metabolite in alkaptonuria.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Biotinidase deficiency prevents efficient recycling of biotin, reducing activity of multiple biotin-dependent carboxylases and causing neurologic and cutaneous disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect biotinidase deficiency with impaired carboxylase function.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PEX gene defects impair peroxisome biogenesis, disrupting very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation and plasmalogen synthesis across multiple tissues.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify peroxisomal biogenesis failure in Zellweger syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Alpha-L-iduronidase deficiency causes lysosomal accumulation of dermatan sulfate and heparan sulfate, producing coarse features, organomegaly, skeletal disease, and developmental decline.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Hurler from Hunter syndrome using enzyme defect and corneal clouding.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: NPC1 or NPC2 defects impair intracellular cholesterol and lipid trafficking from lysosomes, causing progressive neurodegeneration and visceral lipid accumulation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify defective lysosomal cholesterol trafficking in Niemann-Pick type C.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MEFV pathogenic variants dysregulate pyrin inflammasome activity and interleukin-1-mediated innate inflammation, causing recurrent self-limited fever and serositis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish autoinflammatory FMF from adaptive autoimmune disorders.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Random allocation tends to distribute both known and unknown confounders between treatment groups, improving causal inference.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain why randomization strengthens causal inference in clinical trials.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: In retrospective studies, cases may remember or report past exposures differently from controls because disease status influences recall.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize recall bias in retrospective exposure assessment.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Earlier diagnosis through screening can increase measured survival time from diagnosis without changing the actual time of death.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize lead-time bias in cancer screening studies.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A type I error occurs when the null hypothesis is rejected even though it is true; its probability is alpha.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish type I from type II statistical error.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Allocation concealment prevents recruiters from predicting the next assignment and selectively enrolling participants.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish allocation concealment from blinding and identify its protection against selection bias.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Effective serious-news communication acknowledges and explores emotion before delivering more complex information, supporting comprehension and therapeutic alliance.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use empathic acknowledgment when a patient shows strong emotion after serious news.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Clinical decision-making capacity requires the ability to understand relevant information, appreciate consequences, reason about options, and communicate a choice.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish appreciation from understanding in capacity assessment.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Private time with adolescents facilitates disclosure of sensitive health concerns; confidentiality and its limits should be explained according to applicable law and safety obligations.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use appropriate confidential communication practices in adolescent care.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A capable adult may refuse recommended treatment after receiving understandable information about risks, benefits, alternatives, and likely consequences.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Respect informed refusal by a patient with decision-making capacity.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: When an incapacitated patient has a surrogate, decisions should preferentially reflect the patient's known values and prior wishes; best-interest reasoning is used when preferences are unknown.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply substituted judgment when an incapacitated patient's values are known.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Closed-loop communication requires the receiver to repeat back the message and the sender to confirm or correct it, reducing ambiguity in high-risk team tasks.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize closed-loop communication in high-risk clinical teamwork.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Motivational interviewing uses collaborative, nonjudgmental exploration of ambivalence and patient-generated reasons for change rather than confrontation or coercion.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use motivational interviewing to explore ambivalence about smoking cessation.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Neural crest cells migrate extensively and form structures including melanocytes, peripheral sensory and autonomic ganglia, Schwann cells, adrenal medulla, and much of the craniofacial skeleton.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize major neural crest derivatives from a multisystem developmental phenotype.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Müllerian ducts normally form the uterus, fallopian tubes, cervix, and upper vagina; congenital agenesis causes absent uterine structures despite normal ovarian function and secondary sexual characteristics.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify Müllerian duct derivatives in a patient with congenital absence of the uterus.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Defects in erythrocyte cytoskeletal proteins, often spectrin, impair horizontal membrane stability and produce elliptical red cells with variable hemolysis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate hereditary elliptocytosis to erythrocyte membrane cytoskeletal instability.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Severe beta-globin deficiency causes excess unpaired alpha chains, ineffective erythropoiesis, hemolysis, marrow expansion, and severe microcytic anemia beginning after fetal hemoglobin declines.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize beta-thalassemia major from infancy-onset severe microcytic anemia and electrophoresis findings.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Deficiency of the platelet GPIb-IX-V complex impairs platelet adhesion to von Willebrand factor at sites of vascular injury and causes thrombocytopenia with giant platelets.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate platelet adhesion defects from aggregation defects using receptor function.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Deficiency of platelet GPIIb/IIIa prevents fibrinogen-mediated platelet cross-linking and aggregation while platelet adhesion remains intact.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish Glanzmann thrombasthenia from receptor-specific platelet signaling disorders by absent aggregation to multiple agonists with preserved ristocetin-induced agglutination.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Abnormal development of the third and fourth pharyngeal pouches causes thymic hypoplasia and parathyroid hypoplasia, producing T-cell deficiency and hypocalcemia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect thymic developmental failure with T-cell immunodeficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: WAS protein deficiency disrupts actin cytoskeleton signaling in hematopoietic cells, causing combined immunodeficiency, eczema, and microthrombocytopenia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome from its classic triad and platelet morphology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: CD40 ligand deficiency on activated T cells prevents B-cell class-switch recombination, causing high or normal IgM with very low IgG, IgA, and IgE.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain hyper-IgM syndrome through defective T-cell help for B-cell class switching.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Selective failure of IgA production reduces mucosal antibody defense while other immunoglobulin classes are relatively preserved.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate selective IgA deficiency to impaired mucosal immunity.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Allergen cross-linking of IgE bound to FcεRI on mast cells triggers rapid release of histamine and other mediators.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the initiating mechanism of type I hypersensitivity.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Circulating antigen-antibody immune complexes deposit in tissues, activate complement, and recruit inflammatory cells, causing fever, rash, arthralgia, and sometimes nephritis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize type III hypersensitivity from delayed systemic immune-complex disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Preformed recipient antibodies against donor ABO or HLA antigens activate complement and thrombosis immediately after reperfusion, causing rapid graft ischemia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate hyperacute rejection from acute and chronic rejection by timing and antibody mechanism.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MCA territory ischemia commonly causes contralateral face-arm weakness and sensory loss greater than leg involvement, with aphasia in dominant hemisphere lesions or neglect in nondominant lesions.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize a dominant MCA stroke using cortical language and motor findings.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The ACA supplies medial frontal and parietal cortex, including leg motor-sensory regions and circuits involved in initiation and bladder control.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize leg-predominant cortical stroke findings to the ACA.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Compression of the optic chiasm injures crossing nasal retinal fibers, causing loss of temporal visual fields in both eyes.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict visual-field loss from optic chiasm compression.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A lesion posterior to the optic chiasm affects fibers representing the same contralateral visual hemifield from both eyes.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize homonymous visual-field loss to the contralateral retrochiasmal pathway.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cortical alpha-synuclein pathology causes fluctuating cognition, recurrent visual hallucinations, REM sleep behavior disorder, and spontaneous parkinsonism.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Lewy body dementia from Alzheimer and other dementias.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Degeneration of frontal and anterior temporal lobes causes early personality, behavioral, executive, or language dysfunction with relatively preserved memory early in disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link behavioral-variant frontotemporal dementia to frontal/anterior temporal degeneration.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Compression of the median nerve beneath the transverse carpal ligament causes sensory symptoms in the lateral 3.5 digits and weakness/atrophy of thenar muscles.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize carpal tunnel syndrome to the median nerve.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Ulnar nerve dysfunction impairs interossei and medial hand sensation, causing weak finger abduction/adduction and numbness of the fifth digit; compression may occur at the elbow or wrist depending on the clinical context.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize intrinsic hand weakness and fifth-digit numbness to the ulnar nerve without overcalling the lesion site.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cluster headache is a trigeminal autonomic cephalalgia causing brief, excruciating unilateral orbital pain with ipsilateral lacrimation, rhinorrhea, and restlessness in stereotyped clusters.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate cluster headache from migraine and trigeminal neuralgia.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cortical spreading depolarization is implicated in migraine aura and produces transient positive and negative neurologic symptoms that typically evolve over minutes before headache.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect gradually evolving visual aura to cortical spreading depolarization.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of hypothalamic hypocretin/orexin-producing neurons destabilizes sleep-wake regulation and causes excessive daytime sleepiness, cataplexy, sleep paralysis, and hypnagogic hallucinations.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate cataplexy and sleep attacks to orexin deficiency.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Major depressive disorder is defined by at least 2 weeks of depressed mood or loss of interest plus associated cognitive, vegetative, and psychomotor symptoms causing impairment, without mania.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize major depressive disorder from duration, symptom count, and absence of mania.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chronic inflammatory sacroiliitis and enthesitis in axial spondyloarthritis cause inflammatory back pain, progressive spinal stiffness, and reduced chest expansion, often associated with HLA-B27.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize axial spondyloarthritis from inflammatory back pain and sacroiliitis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of self-tolerance leads to autoantibody formation against nuclear antigens and immune-complex deposition in multiple organs.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain SLE tissue injury as a type III hypersensitivity process.
