construct_inventory.tested_construct: Defective mineralization of mature osteoid, commonly from vitamin D deficiency, produces bone pain and weakness with low phosphate or calcium and elevated alkaline phosphatase.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate osteomalacia from osteoporosis by the mineralization defect.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Defective osteoclast-mediated bone resorption produces abnormally dense but brittle bone and can narrow marrow spaces, causing fractures, anemia, and cranial nerve compression.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect diffuse increased bone density with osteoclast dysfunction.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Ewing sarcoma is a malignant small round cell tumor of bone, often caused by EWSR1-FLI1 fusion, typically arising in the diaphysis of long bones or pelvis in children and adolescents.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Ewing sarcoma from osteosarcoma by age, location, and radiographic pattern.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: UV-induced DNA damage and Hedgehog pathway dysregulation drive a locally invasive keratinocyte cancer that rarely metastasizes.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize basal cell carcinoma from its characteristic morphology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cumulative UV exposure causes keratinocyte DNA damage and malignant transformation, often arising from actinic keratoses on sun-exposed skin.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma arising from actinic keratosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoimmune destruction of melanocytes causes sharply demarcated depigmented macules and patches with preserved skin texture.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect autoimmune depigmentation with melanocyte loss.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Rapid bacterial spread along fascial planes causes thrombosis, tissue necrosis, systemic toxicity, and pain often disproportionate to early skin findings.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize necrotizing soft-tissue infection from early high-risk clinical features.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Skin-barrier dysfunction and type 2 immune responses promote chronic pruritic eczematous inflammation, often associated with asthma and allergic rhinitis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain atopic dermatitis through skin-barrier failure and atopic immune activation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Narrowing of the mitral valve obstructs left atrial emptying, increasing left atrial pressure and predisposing to pulmonary congestion, atrial fibrillation, and thromboembolism.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Diagnose mitral stenosis from characteristic murmur and rheumatic history.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Myxomatous degeneration allows mitral leaflets to billow into the left atrium during systole, producing a midsystolic click and sometimes late systolic regurgitation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect a midsystolic click with leaflet prolapse.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A left-to-right atrial shunt increases right-sided volume and pulmonary blood flow, delaying pulmonic valve closure and producing a fixed split S2.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain fixed splitting of S2 in atrial septal defect.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Persistent ductal patency after birth allows continuous flow from higher-pressure aorta to pulmonary artery, increasing pulmonary blood flow and producing a continuous murmur.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the continuous murmur and bounding pulses of PDA through aortic-to-pulmonary shunting.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Bacteremia can seed damaged or abnormal endocardial surfaces, producing infected vegetations that cause persistent fever, new murmurs, emboli, and immune phenomena.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize tricuspid infective endocarditis from risk factors and septic pulmonary emboli.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Sustained elevation of systemic arterial pressure increases left ventricular afterload and stimulates concentric hypertrophic remodeling to normalize wall stress.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict ventricular remodeling from chronic systemic hypertension.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: High intramyocardial pressure during left ventricular systole compresses coronary vessels, so most left coronary blood flow occurs during diastole.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate tachycardia to reduced left coronary perfusion time.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Standing transiently lowers venous return and arterial pressure, decreasing carotid and aortic baroreceptor firing and increasing sympathetic output while reducing parasympathetic tone.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict the immediate baroreceptor response to orthostatic stress.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Systemic inflammatory mediators cause widespread vasodilation and reduced systemic vascular resistance; cardiac output may initially be elevated, producing warm extremities despite hypotension.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize distributive hemodynamics in early sepsis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Sarcoidosis causes noncaseating granulomatous inflammation, commonly affecting hilar lymph nodes and lungs and sometimes skin, eyes, and calcium metabolism.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize pulmonary sarcoidosis from characteristic imaging and pathology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A one-way pleural air leak raises intrathoracic pressure, collapses the ipsilateral lung, shifts mediastinal structures, and obstructs venous return, causing shock.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain hypotension in tension pneumothorax through impaired venous return.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Perfusion of poorly ventilated alveoli lowers local V/Q ratio and arterial oxygenation; supplemental oxygen usually improves hypoxemia unless a true shunt dominates.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify low V/Q physiology in pneumonia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Pulmonary arterial obstruction creates ventilated alveoli with little or no perfusion, increasing physiologic dead space and regional V/Q toward infinity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate pulmonary embolism to high V/Q dead-space physiology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Fluid accumulation in the pleural space compresses adjacent lung and produces decreased breath sounds and dullness to percussion.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize pleural effusion from physical examination findings.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Addition of unmeasured organic acids lowers serum bicarbonate and increases the anion gap.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Calculate the anion gap in metabolic acidosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of gastric hydrochloric acid removes hydrogen and chloride while volume contraction increases renal bicarbonate retention and aldosterone activity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize vomiting as a cause of metabolic alkalosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Efferent arteriolar dilation lowers glomerular capillary hydrostatic pressure and therefore lowers GFR, especially when renal perfusion is already reduced.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain ACE-inhibitor-associated creatinine rise in renal artery stenosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Calcium oxalate supersaturation produces radiopaque stones with envelope- or dumbbell-shaped crystals; hypercalciuria is a common risk factor.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis from crystal morphology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Failure of alpha-intercalated cells to secrete hydrogen ions prevents urinary acidification, causing non-anion-gap metabolic acidosis, high urine pH, hypokalemia, and nephrolithiasis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate distal RTA from proximal RTA using urine pH and nephrolithiasis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Hypoaldosteronism or aldosterone resistance reduces distal sodium reabsorption and potassium/hydrogen secretion, causing hyperkalemic non-anion-gap metabolic acidosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize type 4 RTA from hyperkalemia and non-anion-gap acidosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The thick ascending limb reabsorbs Na-K-2Cl while remaining water-impermeable, diluting tubular fluid and generating the corticomedullary osmotic gradient used for urine concentration.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain how the thick ascending limb supports urine concentration.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Urothelial carcinoma commonly presents with painless gross hematuria; cigarette smoking is a major risk factor due to urinary excretion of carcinogens.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize bladder cancer from painless hematuria and smoking risk.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Transient or chronic incompetence of the lower esophageal sphincter permits reflux of gastric contents into the esophagus, causing heartburn and regurgitation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize GERD from typical reflux symptoms.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Excess acid exposure and impaired mucosal defense, commonly from H pylori infection or NSAIDs, produce mucosal ulceration in the duodenum.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate typical peptic ulcer pain pattern to duodenal location.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Accelerated heme breakdown increases bilirubin production beyond hepatic conjugating capacity, raising unconjugated bilirubin without bilirubinuria.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate unconjugated hemolytic jaundice from conjugated hyperbilirubinemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Bile duct obstruction prevents excretion of conjugated bilirubin into the intestine, increasing serum direct bilirubin, bilirubinuria, pale stools, and often alkaline phosphatase.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize conjugated hyperbilirubinemia in extrahepatic obstruction.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Luminal obstruction causes appendiceal distention, ischemia, bacterial overgrowth, and inflammation, producing visceral periumbilical pain that localizes to the right lower quadrant when parietal peritoneum is involved.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the characteristic pain migration of acute appendicitis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Gastrinoma cells paradoxically release gastrin after intravenous secretin, unlike normal G cells.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Interpret a secretin stimulation test in suspected Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Nutrients in the duodenum and jejunum stimulate I cells to release cholecystokinin.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify intestinal I cells as the source of cholecystokinin after fat and protein enter the small bowel.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Vitamin B12 binds intrinsic factor secreted by gastric parietal cells and the complex is absorbed in the terminal ileum.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize vitamin B12 absorption to the terminal ileum.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Postviral inflammatory destruction of thyroid follicles releases preformed hormone, causing transient thyrotoxicosis with a painful tender thyroid followed by hypothyroid recovery phase.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate subacute thyroiditis from Graves disease by pain and inflammatory context.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Low thyroid hormone removes negative feedback from hypothalamus and pituitary, increasing TRH and TSH secretion in primary thyroid failure.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply endocrine negative feedback to primary thyroid failure.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ACTH and cortisol secretion follow a circadian rhythm with highest levels near early morning awakening and lower levels near midnight.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recall the normal circadian rhythm of cortisol secretion.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: CYP11B1 deficiency lowers cortisol while accumulating deoxycorticosterone and androgen precursors, causing hypertension, hypokalemia, and virilization.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate CAH enzyme defects using blood pressure and androgen pattern.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Severe relative insulin deficiency in type 2 diabetes causes extreme hyperglycemia and osmotic diuresis without the marked ketogenesis typical of absolute insulin deficiency.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate HHS from DKA.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The insulin receptor is a receptor tyrosine kinase that autophosphorylates and activates intracellular signaling pathways promoting glucose uptake and anabolic metabolism.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the receptor class used by insulin.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Sustained high estradiol from the dominant follicle switches to positive feedback on the hypothalamic-pituitary axis, triggering an LH surge that induces ovulation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the hormonal trigger of ovulation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Human chorionic gonadotropin from syncytiotrophoblast maintains the corpus luteum and progesterone production until placental steroidogenesis is sufficient.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the key endocrine role of hCG in early pregnancy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Placental implantation over or near the cervical os predisposes to painless third-trimester vaginal bleeding as the lower uterine segment changes.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate placenta previa from placental abruption.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Premature separation of the placenta from the uterine wall causes painful bleeding, uterine tenderness, fetal compromise, and risk of consumptive coagulopathy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the clinical syndrome of placental abruption.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: FSH acts on Sertoli cells to support spermatogenesis, produce inhibin B, and maintain the blood-testis barrier; LH stimulates Leydig cell testosterone production.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Sertoli from Leydig cell endocrine roles.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Failure to convert testosterone to dihydrotestosterone impairs masculinization of external genitalia and prostate in 46,XY individuals while internal Wolffian structures can develop.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain 46,XY undervirilization from impaired DHT synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Ovarian epithelial malignancies often present late with nonspecific abdominal symptoms, bloating, early satiety, ascites, and adnexal masses.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the common nonspecific presentation of epithelial ovarian cancer.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoantibodies against phospholipid-binding proteins promote arterial and venous thrombosis and recurrent pregnancy morbidity despite possible prolongation of phospholipid-dependent clotting assays in vitro.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize antiphospholipid syndrome from thrombosis, pregnancy morbidity, and lupus anticoagulant physiology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Porphobilinogen deaminase deficiency causes accumulation of porphyrin precursors, producing episodic neurovisceral symptoms without photosensitivity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate acute intermittent porphyria from cutaneous porphyrias.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase deficiency causes porphyrin accumulation and blistering photosensitivity on sun-exposed skin, often with hepatic risk factors.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the enzyme defect in porphyria cutanea tarda.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Deficiency of methylmalonyl-CoA mutase or its cobalamin cofactor pathway prevents conversion of methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA, causing metabolic acidosis and neurologic toxicity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the blocked metabolic reaction in methylmalonic acidemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Propionyl-CoA carboxylase deficiency blocks conversion of propionyl-CoA to methylmalonyl-CoA, causing toxic organic acid accumulation, metabolic acidosis, hyperammonemia, and neonatal illness.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect propionic acidemia with a biotin-dependent carboxylase defect.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Fumarylacetoacetate hydrolase deficiency causes accumulation of toxic tyrosine metabolites including succinylacetone, leading to liver failure and renal tubular dysfunction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the enzyme defect in tyrosinemia type I.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Argininosuccinate lyase deficiency blocks cleavage of argininosuccinate to arginine and fumarate, causing hyperammonemia and argininosuccinate accumulation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize a urea-cycle block from the accumulating intermediate.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Argininosuccinate synthetase deficiency blocks condensation of citrulline with aspartate, causing citrulline accumulation and hyperammonemia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify argininosuccinate synthetase deficiency from hypercitrullinemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ATP7A deficiency impairs intestinal copper export and delivery to copper-dependent enzymes, causing neurodegeneration, connective-tissue abnormalities, and kinky sparse hair.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Menkes from Wilson disease by copper transport protein and phenotype.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: C1 esterase inhibitor deficiency permits excess kallikrein activity and bradykinin generation, causing recurrent nonpruritic edema without urticaria.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate bradykinin-mediated hereditary angioedema from allergic histamine-mediated edema.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A cohort study classifies participants by exposure status before outcome occurrence and follows them forward to compare incidence between exposed and unexposed groups.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify a prospective cohort design from exposure classification and longitudinal follow-up.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Case-control studies select participants based on outcome status and compare prior exposures, making the odds ratio the principal measure of association.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify case-control design from outcome-based sampling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Periodic screening preferentially detects slower-growing disease with a longer preclinical phase, making screened cases appear to have better prognosis even without mortality benefit.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate length-time bias from lead-time bias in screening studies.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A type II error occurs when a false null hypothesis is not rejected; statistical power equals 1 minus beta and rises with adequate sample size and larger effect size.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize type II error and its relationship to low statistical power.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Absolute risk reduction is the event rate in the control group minus the event rate in the treatment group and directly quantifies the absolute treatment benefit.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Calculate absolute risk reduction from treatment and control event rates.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Structured handoffs reduce omissions and ambiguity by standardizing transfer of illness severity, clinical summary, action items, contingency plans, and opportunities for questions.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use structured handoff communication to reduce preventable patient-safety errors.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: TeamSTEPPS uses graded assertive communication such as CUS—Concerned, Uncomfortable, Safety issue—to escalate unresolved patient-safety threats.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply graded assertiveness to unresolved patient-safety concerns.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Plain language reduces cognitive and literacy barriers by using familiar words, short explanations, concrete actions, and limited key points.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use plain language and teach-back to support safe medication use.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Serious-illness decision making should connect treatment options to the patient's values, goals, acceptable function, and tradeoffs rather than focus only on procedures.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Elicit patient values to guide serious-illness treatment decisions.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Therapeutic misconception occurs when research participants incorrectly believe that study interventions are chosen solely for their personal clinical benefit rather than to answer a research question under a protocol.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize and correct therapeutic misconception during research consent.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Read-back requires the receiver to repeat critical verbal information so the sender can verify accuracy, reducing errors from mishearing or transcription.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use read-back for critical verbal laboratory results.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Decision aids present evidence-based options, benefits, harms, and value-sensitive tradeoffs to support—not replace—clinician-patient deliberation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use decision aids appropriately in preference-sensitive treatment choices.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The first pharyngeal arch contributes to maxillary and mandibular structures and is innervated by CN V3.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify first pharyngeal arch derivatives.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Endocardial cushions contribute to atrioventricular septation and valve formation; failure of fusion produces AV septal defects.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify endocardial cushions as the embryologic source of AV septation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Pyruvate kinase deficiency lowers ATP production in mature RBCs, which depend entirely on glycolysis, causing membrane failure and chronic hemolysis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain hemolysis in pyruvate kinase deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: IgG autoantibodies bind RBCs at body temperature and promote splenic extravascular hemolysis, often producing spherocytes and a positive direct antiglobulin test.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify IgG as the principal antibody class in warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Inflammation increases hepcidin, reducing ferroportin-mediated iron export from enterocytes and macrophages and lowering circulating iron despite preserved or increased stores.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain anemia of chronic inflammation through hepcidin.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Depleted iron stores limit heme synthesis, producing microcytic hypochromic erythrocytes, low ferritin, and increased TIBC.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate iron deficiency from other microcytic anemias.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Vitamin K is required for gamma-carboxylation of glutamate residues in factors II, VII, IX, X and proteins C and S, enabling calcium binding and coagulation activity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the vitamin K-dependent coagulation modification.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Classical Hodgkin lymphoma is characterized by malignant Reed-Sternberg cells in an inflammatory background and often spreads contiguously between lymph node groups.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the B-cell origin of Reed-Sternberg cells.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MYC translocation, commonly t(8;14), causes intense proliferative signaling in a highly aggressive B-cell lymphoma.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate Burkitt lymphoma with MYC activation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: t(14;18) juxtaposes BCL2 to the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus, causing antiapoptotic BCL2 overexpression.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect t(14;18) follicular lymphoma with inhibited apoptosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Clonal proliferation of lymphoid precursors in bone marrow suppresses normal hematopoiesis and may infiltrate CNS, testes, liver, spleen, and nodes.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize childhood ALL.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Clonal myeloid precursor proliferation with impaired differentiation causes marrow failure; myeloblasts may contain Auer rods from fused azurophilic granules.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the myeloid lineage of AML.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Clonal plasma cells produce monoclonal immunoglobulin and osteoclast-activating factors, causing lytic bone lesions, anemia, renal injury, and hypercalcemia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain lytic bone disease in multiple myeloma.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Degeneration of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra pars compacta reduces striatal dopamine and produces bradykinesia, rigidity, resting tremor, and postural instability.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Parkinson disease from its core motor features.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Essential tremor is a common action/postural tremor syndrome involving cerebello-thalamo-cortical circuits and often improves transiently with alcohol.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate essential tremor from Parkinson tremor.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoimmune CNS demyelination produces neurologic deficits disseminated in time and space, including optic neuritis, internuclear ophthalmoplegia, sensory deficits, and upper motor neuron signs.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify oligodendrocytes as the myelinating cells injured in multiple sclerosis.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acute immune-mediated peripheral nerve and root demyelination or axonal injury often follows infection and causes symmetric ascending weakness with areflexia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Guillain-Barré syndrome.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoantibodies against postsynaptic nicotinic acetylcholine receptors or related proteins reduce the safety factor for neuromuscular transmission and cause fatigable weakness.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the postsynaptic target in myasthenia gravis.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PMP22 duplication causes inherited peripheral myelin dysfunction with slowly progressive distal weakness, pes cavus, and reduced reflexes.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate CMT1A with PMP22 duplication.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Anterior spinal artery infarction injures corticospinal and spinothalamic tracts while often sparing dorsal columns supplied by posterior spinal arteries.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize anterior spinal artery infarction using tract deficits.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Each cerebellar hemisphere coordinates ipsilateral limb movement through double-crossed pathways; lesions cause ipsilateral dysmetria, intention tremor, and ataxia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict ipsilateral cerebellar findings.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: CAG repeat expansion in HTT causes progressive degeneration of striatal neurons, especially caudate, producing chorea, psychiatric symptoms, and dementia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect Huntington disease with caudate degeneration.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Alzheimer disease features extracellular beta-amyloid plaques and intracellular hyperphosphorylated tau neurofibrillary tangles with progressive synaptic and neuronal loss.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify characteristic Alzheimer pathology.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Absence seizures involve thalamocortical oscillations and cause brief staring spells with immediate recovery, classically associated with generalized 3-Hz spike-and-wave activity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize childhood absence epilepsy.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Sudden obstruction of aqueous humor outflow through the trabecular meshwork rapidly raises intraocular pressure, causing ocular pain, halos, headache, nausea, and a fixed mid-dilated pupil.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize acute angle-closure glaucoma.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoimmune synovitis causes symmetric inflammatory polyarthritis with pannus formation, cartilage destruction, and marginal erosions.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain joint erosion in rheumatoid arthritis through pannus formation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Progressive loss of articular cartilage with subchondral bone remodeling and osteophyte formation causes activity-related pain and brief morning stiffness.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the primary tissue pathology of osteoarthritis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Monosodium urate crystals deposit in joints when urate is supersaturated, causing intense neutrophil-mediated inflammation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize gout by joint pattern and crystal morphology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: T-cell-mediated inflammatory myopathy causes symmetric proximal muscle weakness with elevated muscle enzymes but no characteristic dermatomyositis rash.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate inflammatory myopathy from neuropathic and NMJ causes of weakness.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Excessive disorganized osteoclastic resorption followed by compensatory osteoblastic bone formation produces enlarged structurally weak bone and elevated alkaline phosphatase.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain Paget disease as high-turnover disorganized remodeling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Vitamin C is required for hydroxylation of proline and lysine residues in collagen, stabilizing the triple helix; deficiency causes fragile vessels and impaired wound healing.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect scurvy with impaired collagen hydroxylation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Defects in collagen synthesis or processing produce hyperextensible skin, joint hypermobility, easy bruising, and tissue fragility.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Ehlers-Danlos syndrome from connective-tissue fragility.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: FBN1 mutations impair fibrillin-rich microfibrils and dysregulate TGF-beta signaling, causing skeletal overgrowth, lens dislocation, and aortic root disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate Marfan syndrome with fibrillin-1 defects.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Superficial bacterial infection of the epidermis, commonly due to S aureus or group A streptococci, produces fragile vesicles/pustules and honey-colored crusts.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize impetigo from characteristic morphology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Bacterial infection of dermis and subcutaneous tissue causes expanding erythema, warmth, edema, and tenderness, commonly from streptococci or S aureus.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish cellulitis from superficial and deep necrotizing infection by tissue depth.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chronic pressure overload and myocardial stiffening impair ventricular relaxation and filling despite preserved systolic ejection fraction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize HFpEF from preserved EF and diastolic dysfunction context.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Within physiologic limits, increased ventricular end-diastolic fiber length increases force of contraction and stroke volume.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply the Frank-Starling relationship.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: For a pressurized ventricular chamber, wall stress rises with chamber radius and pressure and falls with greater wall thickness.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict wall-stress changes from ventricular geometry.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cardiac beta-1 receptors couple to Gs, increasing adenylyl cyclase activity, cAMP, protein kinase A signaling, heart rate, and contractility.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the second-messenger pathway of cardiac beta-1 receptors.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Ventricular dilation and systolic dysfunction reduce ejection fraction and can cause functional mitral regurgitation and congestive heart failure.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize dilated cardiomyopathy from chamber geometry and systolic dysfunction.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Infiltration or fibrosis stiffens ventricular walls, causing severe diastolic filling impairment with relatively preserved systolic function early.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the dominant physiology of restrictive cardiomyopathy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Degenerative weakening of the abdominal aortic wall, strongly associated with smoking and atherosclerotic risk, causes progressive dilation and rupture risk.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain aneurysm formation through loss of aortic wall structural integrity.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Atherosclerotic narrowing of lower-extremity arteries limits exercise hyperemia, causing exertional claudication relieved by rest.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain intermittent claudication in PAD.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Venous valve incompetence causes ambulatory venous hypertension, edema, hemosiderin deposition, stasis dermatitis, and medial ankle ulcers.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the pathophysiology of chronic venous insufficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chronic irritant exposure causes mucus gland enlargement, goblet-cell hyperplasia, and chronic productive cough with airflow obstruction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize chronic bronchitis clinically.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Protease-antiprotease imbalance and oxidant injury destroy alveolar walls, enlarge distal airspaces, reduce elastic recoil, and promote expiratory airway collapse.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain air trapping in emphysema.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Mycobacterium tuberculosis causes granulomatous pulmonary infection that can present with chronic cough, fever, night sweats, weight loss, and upper-lobe cavitation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the characteristic granulomatous immune response in tuberculosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Profound T-cell immunodeficiency predisposes to diffuse Pneumocystis infection causing nonproductive cough, fever, hypoxemia, and bilateral interstitial opacities.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize PCP in advanced HIV.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Small cell lung cancer is a central neuroendocrine carcinoma strongly associated with smoking and may produce ectopic ACTH or ADH.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate small cell lung cancer with SIADH.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Smoking-related squamous carcinoma often arises centrally and can secrete PTH-related peptide, causing humoral hypercalcemia of malignancy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize PTHrP paraneoplastic hypercalcemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Podocyte foot-process effacement causes selective albuminuria and nephrotic syndrome, especially in children; light microscopy is often normal.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize minimal change disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Podocyte injury causes focal and segmental glomerular scarring and nephrotic syndrome, associated with HIV, obesity, reduced nephron mass, and certain genetic variants.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize FSGS from biopsy pattern and associations.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Subepithelial immune deposits along glomerular capillary walls activate complement and injure podocytes, causing nephrotic proteinuria.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize immune deposits in membranous nephropathy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduced renal perfusion with intact tubular function increases sodium and water reabsorption, often yielding low urine sodium and low fractional excretion of sodium.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain low urine sodium in prerenal AKI.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Ischemic or nephrotoxic tubular epithelial injury causes cell sloughing, granular casts, impaired concentrating ability, and intrinsic AKI.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize acute tubular necrosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Drug-triggered hypersensitivity inflammation of the renal interstitium and tubules can cause AKI with fever, rash, eosinophilia, pyuria, and WBC casts.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize drug-induced acute interstitial nephritis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduced phosphate excretion and reduced renal calcitriol production lower ionized calcium and stimulate parathyroid hormone secretion in chronic kidney disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain secondary hyperparathyroidism in CKD.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Diffuse hepatic fibrosis and regenerative nodules increase intrahepatic resistance, causing portal hypertension, ascites, varices, and splenomegaly.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize cirrhosis from structural and portal-hypertensive findings.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Portal hypertension and splanchnic vasodilation reduce effective arterial volume, activating RAAS and sodium retention; low albumin can further favor fluid movement into the peritoneum.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain renal sodium retention in cirrhotic ascites.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of pancreatic lipase and other digestive enzymes impairs nutrient digestion, especially fat, causing steatorrhea and fat-soluble vitamin deficiency.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link pancreatic exocrine failure to lipase deficiency and fat malabsorption.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduced brush-border lactase leaves lactose unabsorbed, causing osmotic diarrhea and bacterial fermentation with bloating and gas.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize lactose intolerance from dietary trigger and symptom pattern.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Inflammation and microperforation of a colonic diverticulum, usually in the sigmoid colon, causes left lower quadrant pain, fever, and leukocytosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize acute diverticulitis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Colonic bacteria ferment unabsorbed carbohydrates and fiber to short-chain fatty acids, which colonocytes can use as fuel and which influence water and electrolyte absorption.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify a key metabolic product of colonic bacterial fermentation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chronic cirrhosis and viral hepatitis increase risk for primary hepatocellular malignancy, which may present with worsening liver disease, mass, weight loss, and elevated alpha-fetoprotein.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize HCC risk factors and tumor marker association.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Some gastrointestinal neuroendocrine tumors produce serotonin; liver metastases can allow vasoactive mediators to reach systemic circulation and cause flushing, diarrhea, bronchospasm, and right-sided valvular fibrosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect carcinoid syndrome with serotonin secretion.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Papillary thyroid carcinoma is the most common thyroid malignancy, often associated with BRAF or RET/PTC alterations and characterized by papillary architecture, nuclear grooves, and psammoma bodies.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize papillary thyroid carcinoma histology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Follicular thyroid carcinoma is distinguished from follicular adenoma by capsular and/or vascular invasion and tends to spread hematogenously.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate follicular carcinoma from adenoma histologically.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Thyroid peroxidase oxidizes iodide, iodinates tyrosine residues on thyroglobulin, and couples iodotyrosines to form T3 and T4.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the enzymatic functions of thyroid peroxidase.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Tyrosine hydroxylase converts tyrosine to DOPA and is the rate-limiting step in catecholamine biosynthesis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the rate-limiting enzyme in catecholamine synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Zona glomerulosa cells produce aldosterone under regulation by angiotensin II and potassium; they lack 17-alpha-hydroxylase activity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify adrenal cortical zonation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Growth hormone acts through a cytokine receptor associated with JAK2-STAT signaling and stimulates hepatic IGF-1 production.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify GH receptor signaling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Calcitriol increases intestinal absorption of calcium and phosphate and participates in bone-mineral homeostasis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recall calcitriol effects on intestinal mineral absorption.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: LH stimulates Leydig cells through cAMP to produce testosterone; testosterone supports male differentiation and spermatogenesis indirectly.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Leydig and Sertoli cell endocrine functions.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: After ovulation, the corpus luteum secretes progesterone, converting proliferative endometrium to a secretory state and supporting early implantation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the dominant hormone of the luteal phase.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The placenta lacks significant 17-alpha-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase activity and relies on fetal adrenal DHEA-S as substrate for estrogen synthesis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain fetoplacental cooperation in estrogen synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Prolonged unopposed estrogen exposure promotes endometrial proliferation and increases risk of endometrioid carcinoma.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect chronic unopposed estrogen exposure with endometrial carcinoma risk.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Ectopic endometrial glands and stroma respond to cyclic hormones and cause inflammation, fibrosis, pelvic pain, dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, and infertility.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize endometriosis clinically.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Prostate adenocarcinoma commonly arises in the peripheral zone and can metastasize to bone, often producing osteoblastic lesions.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the bone-metastatic pattern of prostate cancer.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acid alpha-glucosidase deficiency prevents lysosomal glycogen degradation, causing glycogen accumulation in heart and skeletal muscle.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the enzyme defect in Pompe disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Muscle glycogen phosphorylase deficiency prevents skeletal muscle glycogenolysis during exercise, causing cramps, exercise intolerance, and myoglobinuria with a second-wind phenomenon.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize McArdle disease from exercise-induced symptoms.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acid sphingomyelinase deficiency causes sphingomyelin accumulation in macrophages and neurons, leading to hepatosplenomegaly and progressive neurodegeneration.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Niemann-Pick A from Tay-Sachs clinically.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Galactocerebrosidase deficiency causes psychosine accumulation, oligodendrocyte injury, demyelination, and globoid macrophages.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the enzyme defect in Krabbe disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Arylsulfatase A deficiency causes sulfatide accumulation in oligodendrocytes and Schwann cells, producing central and peripheral demyelination.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the stored substrate in metachromatic leukodystrophy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ATM kinase deficiency impairs response to DNA double-strand breaks, causing cerebellar degeneration, telangiectasias, immunodeficiency, radiosensitivity, and cancer risk.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize ataxia-telangiectasia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Defects in the Fanconi DNA repair pathway impair repair of interstrand cross-links, causing chromosomal breakage, congenital anomalies, marrow failure, and cancer predisposition.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the DNA repair defect in Fanconi anemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: BLM helicase deficiency causes excessive homologous recombination and sister-chromatid exchanges, genomic instability, growth deficiency, photosensitivity, and broad cancer predisposition.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect Bloom syndrome with DNA helicase deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of paternally expressed genes in 15q11-q13, commonly from paternal deletion or maternal uniparental disomy, causes neonatal hypotonia followed by hyperphagia, obesity, and hypogonadism.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate Prader-Willi from Angelman by parent of origin.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of maternal UBE3A expression in the brain, commonly from maternal deletion or paternal uniparental disomy, causes severe developmental delay, absent speech, ataxia, seizures, and a happy demeanor.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Angelman syndrome and its parent-of-origin defect.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cross-sectional studies measure exposure and outcome at a single point or brief period and estimate prevalence rather than incidence.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify a cross-sectional design.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Point prevalence is the proportion of a population with a condition at a specified time.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Calculate point prevalence.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Incidence proportion is the number of new cases during a specified period divided by the population initially at risk.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Calculate cumulative incidence.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A confounder is associated with both the exposure and outcome, is not an intermediate in the causal pathway, and distorts the exposure-outcome association.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize a confounding variable.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: For a risk ratio, the null value is 1.0; a conventional 95% CI excluding 1 indicates statistical significance at approximately alpha 0.05 for a two-sided test.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Interpret a confidence interval around a risk ratio.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Informed consent requires understandable disclosure of purpose, expected benefits, material risks, reasonable alternatives, and voluntariness, followed by opportunity for questions and a voluntary choice.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify core elements of informed consent.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Financial or personal interests that could influence professional judgment should be disclosed and managed to preserve trust and reduce biased decision making.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply conflict-of-interest principles in clinical research.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Transparent communication of uncertainty should distinguish what is known, what remains uncertain, what is being done to reduce uncertainty, and what warning signs require reassessment.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Communicate diagnostic uncertainty transparently.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cultural humility uses open inquiry into the individual patient's beliefs and preferences rather than making assumptions based on group identity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use cultural humility rather than stereotyping.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SBAR structures urgent clinical communication as Situation, Background, Assessment, and Recommendation to convey concise actionable information.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize SBAR as a team communication tool.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The two-challenge rule empowers team members to voice a safety concern at least twice and escalate through the chain of command when the initial concern is ignored.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply the two-challenge rule to patient safety.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A health care proxy designates a surrogate to make medical decisions when the patient loses decision-making capacity, ideally guided by the patient's known wishes and values.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate a health care proxy from other advance-planning documents.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Prenatal alcohol exposure disrupts growth and neurodevelopment and can produce characteristic facial abnormalities, impaired cognition, and behavioral dysfunction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize fetal alcohol spectrum disorder.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Maternal rubella infection early in pregnancy can disrupt fetal organogenesis, classically causing sensorineural deafness, cataracts, and congenital heart disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify congenital rubella from its classic triad.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Vitamin B12 deficiency impairs methionine synthase and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, causing megaloblastic anemia plus neurologic injury from methylmalonic acid accumulation and myelin dysfunction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate vitamin B12 from folate deficiency using methylmalonic acid and neurologic findings.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A beta-globin missense variant substitutes lysine for glutamic acid and can cause mild hemolytic anemia with target cells and hemoglobin crystals.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the amino-acid substitution in hemoglobin C.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Defects in spectrin, ankyrin, band 3, or protein 4.2 reduce membrane surface area, causing spherocytes that are trapped and destroyed in the spleen.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain splenic hemolysis in hereditary spherocytosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: X-linked factor IX deficiency impairs intrinsic-pathway coagulation and causes deep tissue bleeding, hemarthroses, prolonged aPTT, and normal platelet count/PT.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate hemophilia B from hemophilia A.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Clonal JAK2 activation drives erythrocytosis independent of erythropoietin and often increases leukocytes and platelets.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize polycythemia vera.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Clonal megakaryocytic proliferation, often due to JAK2, CALR, or MPL mutations, produces persistent thrombocytosis and risk of thrombosis or bleeding.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the dominant lineage in essential thrombocythemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Clonal megakaryocytes release fibrogenic cytokines, leading to marrow fibrosis and extramedullary hematopoiesis with massive splenomegaly and teardrop cells.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain marrow fibrosis in primary myelofibrosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Clonal mature B lymphocytes accumulate in blood, marrow, lymph nodes, and spleen; smudge cells and hypogammaglobulinemia are common.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize CLL.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Profound defects in T-cell development or signaling with secondary impairment of B-cell function cause severe recurrent bacterial, viral, fungal, and opportunistic infections in infancy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize severe combined immunodeficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: C3 is central to all complement activation pathways and generates C3b for opsonization; deficiency causes recurrent severe infections with encapsulated bacteria.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify C3b-mediated opsonization as the key lost function in C3 deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Type IV hypersensitivity is mediated by antigen-specific T cells and macrophage activation rather than antibodies, producing delayed inflammation after exposure.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize type IV hypersensitivity.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Focal seizures arising from temporal lobe networks can cause an aura, impaired awareness, automatisms, and postictal confusion.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize temporal lobe focal seizures.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Prolonged seizure activity causes excessive neuronal excitation, metabolic demand, excitotoxic injury, and systemic complications.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the danger of prolonged convulsive status epilepticus.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Misfolded prion protein induces conformational conversion of normal prion protein, causing rapidly progressive spongiform neurodegeneration.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Radial nerve injury in the spiral groove weakens wrist and finger extensors and can impair dorsal hand sensation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize wrist drop to radial nerve injury.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Compression near the fibular neck injures the common fibular nerve, causing foot drop from weak dorsiflexion and sensory loss over the dorsum of the foot.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize foot drop after fibular-neck compression.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Dorsal columns carry ipsilateral vibration, fine touch, and conscious proprioception in the spinal cord before crossing in the medulla.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict sensory deficits from a dorsal-column spinal lesion.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Pain-temperature fibers enter the spinal cord, ascend or descend a few segments, cross in the anterior white commissure, and then ascend contralaterally.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict deficits from an anterolateral spinal cord lesion.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: CN III innervates most extraocular muscles, levator palpebrae, and parasympathetic pupillary constrictor pathways; lesions cause ptosis, down-and-out eye, and possible mydriasis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize oculomotor nerve palsy.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: CN VI innervates the lateral rectus; injury prevents abduction and causes horizontal diplopia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the muscle affected in CN VI palsy.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A manic episode consists of persistently elevated or irritable mood and increased energy with decreased need for sleep, pressured speech, grandiosity, and impaired judgment severe enough to cause marked impairment.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize mania and bipolar I disorder.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Schizophrenia is a chronic psychotic disorder characterized by delusions, hallucinations, disorganized thought/behavior, and negative symptoms with significant functional decline.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate schizophrenia from shorter-duration psychotic disorders.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chronic impaired aqueous humor outflow through the trabecular meshwork raises or dysregulates intraocular pressure and progressively damages the optic nerve, causing peripheral visual-field loss.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify optic nerve damage in open-angle glaucoma.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Out-of-frame dystrophin mutations cause absent dystrophin, progressive myofiber membrane instability, markedly elevated CK, calf pseudohypertrophy, and cardiomyopathy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Duchenne muscular dystrophy clinically.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: In-frame DMD mutations preserve the reading frame and produce reduced or abnormal dystrophin, yielding a milder later-onset phenotype than Duchenne disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the milder Becker phenotype through the reading-frame rule.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Interruption of blood supply to subchondral bone causes osteocyte death and structural collapse, associated with glucocorticoids, alcohol, trauma, and sickle cell disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize avascular necrosis and its risk factors.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Giant cell tumor usually arises in the epiphysis of long bones after skeletal maturity and contains numerous osteoclast-like giant cells driven by RANKL-expressing stromal cells.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify osteoclast-like giant cells in giant cell tumor of bone.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A lipoma is a benign neoplasm of mature adipocytes that typically presents as a soft, mobile, painless subcutaneous mass.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the tissue of origin of a lipoma.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Immune-mediated keratinocyte hyperproliferation produces sharply demarcated erythematous plaques with silvery scale, often on extensor surfaces and scalp.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize psoriasis clinically.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: T-cell-mediated injury to basal keratinocytes produces pruritic, purple, polygonal, planar papules and can involve oral mucosa.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the immune basis of lichen planus.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoimmune T-cell attack on anagen hair follicles causes sharply demarcated nonscarring hair loss.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the autoimmune mechanism of alopecia areata.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Small chemicals act as haptens and trigger sensitized T-cell responses, causing delayed type IV hypersensitivity at exposed skin sites.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify type IV hypersensitivity in allergic contact dermatitis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: An acute immune-mediated reaction, often triggered by HSV or infection, produces symmetric targetoid lesions and limited mucosal involvement.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize erythema multiforme and distinguish it from SJS.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Fixed atherosclerotic coronary narrowing limits flow reserve, causing predictable exertional ischemia without myocardial necrosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize stable angina clinically.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Atherosclerotic plaque disruption with nonocclusive thrombosis causes acute reduction in coronary flow and ischemia without detectable myocardial necrosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain unstable angina pathogenesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Mean arterial pressure is approximately cardiac output multiplied by systemic vascular resistance; cardiac output equals heart rate times stroke volume.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply the relationship MAP ≈ CO × SVR.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Contraction of limb muscles compresses veins while valves prevent retrograde flow, augmenting venous return during exercise.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the skeletal muscle pump in venous return.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The AV node conducts slowly through calcium-dependent action potentials, creating a delay that permits ventricular filling before ventricular activation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate AV nodal conduction to the PR interval.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Rapid opening of voltage-gated fast sodium channels causes the phase 0 upstroke of ventricular myocyte action potentials.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the ionic basis of ventricular phase 0.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Spontaneous phase 4 depolarization in SA nodal cells reflects funny sodium current and calcium currents, allowing automaticity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain SA nodal automaticity using phase 4 current.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Elevated pulmonary vascular resistance increases right ventricular afterload and can cause RV hypertrophy, loud P2, exertional dyspnea, syncope, and right heart failure.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize pulmonary hypertension clinically.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Long-standing large left-to-right congenital shunts cause pulmonary vascular remodeling and severe pulmonary hypertension, eventually reversing flow to right-to-left and producing cyanosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain Eisenmenger syndrome from long-standing shunt physiology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Type II pneumocytes produce surfactant, which lowers alveolar surface tension, increases compliance, and helps prevent end-expiratory alveolar collapse.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the effect of surfactant deficiency on alveolar mechanics.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Interstitial fibrosis increases elastic stiffness of the lung, reducing compliance and increasing the work required to inflate the lungs.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate pulmonary fibrosis to decreased compliance.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Higher temperature, higher CO2, lower pH, and increased 2,3-BPG reduce hemoglobin oxygen affinity and facilitate tissue unloading.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict oxygen-hemoglobin affinity changes during exercise.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Legionella pneumophila causes atypical pneumonia often associated with high fever, gastrointestinal symptoms, hyponatremia, and exposure to contaminated water systems.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Legionella pneumonia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The polysaccharide capsule is the major virulence factor of S pneumoniae because it inhibits phagocytosis unless opsonizing antibody and complement are present.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the key virulence factor of S pneumoniae.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Filtration fraction equals GFR divided by renal plasma flow.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Calculate filtration fraction.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Renal clearance of a substance equals urine concentration times urine flow divided by plasma concentration.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Calculate renal clearance.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: At low plasma concentrations, para-aminohippurate is filtered and strongly secreted, so nearly all PAH entering the kidney is excreted and its clearance approximates effective renal plasma flow.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify PAH clearance as a measure of effective renal plasma flow.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The proximal tubule reabsorbs most filtered sodium and water, essentially all normal filtered glucose and amino acids, and most bicarbonate.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify a proximal tubular reabsorptive function.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The thick ascending limb reabsorbs NaCl through NKCC2 while remaining nearly impermeable to water, making tubular fluid more dilute.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain why the thick ascending limb dilutes tubular fluid.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Collecting-duct principal cells reabsorb sodium through ENaC under aldosterone influence, secrete potassium, and regulate water permeability through vasopressin-dependent aquaporin-2.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict aldosterone effects on collecting-duct principal cells.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Urinary loss of anticoagulant proteins such as antithrombin contributes to the increased venous thrombosis risk of nephrotic syndrome.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain hypercoagulability in nephrotic syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Wilms tumor is an embryonal renal malignancy of childhood associated with WT1/WT2 pathway abnormalities and presents as a painless abdominal mass, sometimes with hematuria or hypertension.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Wilms tumor clinically.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chronic acid reflux can cause metaplasia of distal esophageal squamous epithelium to intestinal-type columnar epithelium with goblet cells, increasing adenocarcinoma risk.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify intestinal metaplasia in Barrett esophagus.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chronic GERD and Barrett metaplasia predispose to adenocarcinoma of the distal esophagus, presenting with progressive dysphagia and weight loss.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize esophageal adenocarcinoma risk factors and presentation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Autoimmune destruction of gastric parietal cells and intrinsic factor causes vitamin B12 malabsorption and can produce achlorhydria and megaloblastic anemia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify parietal-cell loss in pernicious anemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Dietary iron is absorbed mainly in the duodenum and proximal jejunum; hepcidin regulates ferroportin-mediated export into plasma.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use anatomy plus the anemia pattern to identify iron deficiency after duodenal and proximal jejunal resection.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Most conjugated bile acids are actively reabsorbed in the terminal ileum and returned to the liver through enterohepatic circulation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain consequences of terminal ileal resection.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Many sporadic colorectal cancers develop through sequential genetic alterations including APC loss, KRAS activation, and later TP53 pathway disruption.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify APC as an early colorectal tumor-suppressor loss.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma often arises in the head of the pancreas and can obstruct the common bile duct, causing painless jaundice, dark urine, pale stools, and weight loss.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize pancreatic head adenocarcinoma.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Gastrin from antral G cells stimulates gastric acid secretion largely through enterochromaffin-like cell histamine release and trophic effects on gastric mucosa.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the principal gastric effect of gastrin.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ACTH binds melanocortin-2 receptors on adrenal cortical cells and activates Gs-cAMP signaling, especially in zona fasciculata and reticularis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify ACTH receptor signaling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: TSH binds a Gs-coupled receptor on thyroid follicular cells, raising cAMP and stimulating thyroid hormone synthesis and gland growth.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify TSH receptor signaling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: FSH stimulates granulosa cells to proliferate and express aromatase, converting theca-derived androgens into estrogens.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify granulosa-cell response to FSH.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: LH stimulates theca interna cells to synthesize androgen precursors that granulosa cells aromatize to estrogens.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify theca-cell response to LH.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: CYP17A1 deficiency reduces cortisol and sex steroid synthesis while shunting precursors toward mineralocorticoids, causing hypertension, hypokalemia, and sexual infantilism.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate CAH defects using blood pressure and sex-steroid pattern.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: An autonomously functioning thyroid nodule produces thyroid hormone independent of TSH, suppressing pituitary TSH and surrounding thyroid tissue.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize toxic thyroid adenoma.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Severe postpartum hemorrhage can cause ischemic necrosis of the enlarged anterior pituitary, leading to postpartum failure to lactate and multiple pituitary hormone deficiencies.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Sheehan syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Insulin promotes glucose uptake in muscle and adipose tissue, glycogen synthesis, lipogenesis, and protein synthesis while inhibiting lipolysis and hepatic glucose output.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify a key postprandial insulin effect.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Glucagon acts mainly on liver through Gs-cAMP signaling to increase glycogenolysis, gluconeogenesis, and ketogenesis during fasting.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify hepatic glucagon effects during fasting.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Calcitonin from thyroid C cells lowers serum calcium modestly by inhibiting osteoclast-mediated bone resorption; its physiologic role in adults is limited.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify calcitonin's major bone effect.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Malignant trophoblastic cells produce very high hCG and can invade rapidly and metastasize hematogenously.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize gestational choriocarcinoma.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A complete mole usually results from fertilization of an empty ovum by paternal genetic material, producing androgenetic diploid trophoblastic proliferation without fetal tissue.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the genetic origin of a complete hydatidiform mole.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Twisting of the spermatic cord compromises venous outflow and then arterial supply, causing acute ischemic testicular pain and requiring urgent detorsion.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize testicular torsion as a surgical emergency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Alpha-galactosidase A deficiency causes lysosomal globotriaosylceramide accumulation in vascular endothelium and multiple organs.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the enzyme defect in Fabry disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Glucocerebrosidase deficiency causes glucocerebroside accumulation in macrophages, leading to hepatosplenomegaly, cytopenias, and bone disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the enzyme defect in Gaucher disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Hexosaminidase A deficiency prevents GM2 ganglioside degradation, causing progressive neurodegeneration without hepatosplenomegaly.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the stored substrate in Tay-Sachs disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Iduronate-2-sulfatase deficiency causes dermatan and heparan sulfate accumulation; unlike Hurler syndrome, corneal clouding is absent and inheritance is X-linked.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify iduronate-2-sulfatase deficiency in Hunter syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ATP7B deficiency impairs biliary copper excretion and copper incorporation into ceruloplasmin, causing hepatic and neurologic copper accumulation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify biliary copper excretion as the key ATP7B-dependent process.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Inappropriately low hepcidin signaling increases ferroportin-mediated intestinal iron absorption and macrophage iron release, causing progressive tissue iron deposition.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain iron overload in hereditary hemochromatosis through hepcidin dysregulation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Trisomy 21 most often results from meiotic nondisjunction and is associated with intellectual disability, characteristic facial features, hypotonia, congenital heart disease, and increased leukemia/Alzheimer risk.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize trisomy 21.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Trisomy 18 causes severe developmental abnormalities including growth restriction, prominent occiput, micrognathia, clenched hands with overlapping fingers, rocker-bottom feet, and congenital heart disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Edwards syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Deletion of the short arm of chromosome 5 causes a high-pitched cat-like cry, microcephaly, distinctive facial features, and developmental delay.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the chromosomal lesion in cri-du-chat syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A microdeletion at 7q11.23 including ELN causes characteristic facial features, hypersociability, developmental differences, and supravalvular aortic stenosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect Williams syndrome vascular disease with ELN deletion.
