construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain abetalipoproteinemia as failure of MTTP-dependent lipidation and secretion of apoB-containing lipoproteins.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduced Gs alpha signaling impairs PTH-receptor coupling to adenylyl cyclase, decreasing cAMP generation in target tissues and causing end-organ PTH resistance with hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, and elevated PTH.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate PTH resistance from GNAS inactivation to impaired Gs alpha–adenylyl cyclase–cAMP signaling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: C1-inhibitor deficiency fails to restrain the contact kallikrein-kinin system, causing excessive bradykinin production and episodic increases in vascular permeability without histamine-mediated urticaria.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize hereditary angioedema with C1-inhibitor deficiency as a bradykinin-mediated, not histamine-mediated, disorder.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: With sensitivity and specificity held constant, increasing disease prevalence raises the positive predictive value and lowers the negative predictive value because the pretest probability of disease is higher.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Predict how a change in disease prevalence alters positive and negative predictive values when sensitivity and specificity remain constant.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: When an adult lacks decision-making capacity and prior preferences can be known or reasonably inferred, the surrogate should base decisions on what the patient would have chosen; best-interest reasoning is used when the patient's values and preferences are unknown.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply substituted judgment when a surrogate makes decisions for an incapacitated adult with known prior treatment preferences.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: NPHS1 encodes nephrin, a transmembrane component of the slit diaphragm between podocyte foot processes. Loss of nephrin disrupts the glomerular filtration barrier and produces severe proteinuria beginning in early infancy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link NPHS1-related congenital nephrotic syndrome to loss of the podocyte slit-diaphragm protein nephrin.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Activated factor XIII is a transglutaminase that covalently cross-links fibrin after fibrin formation, stabilizing the clot; factor XIII deficiency can cause significant delayed bleeding despite normal PT and aPTT because routine clotting times measure events before factor XIII-mediated cross-linking.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize factor XIII deficiency as a defect of post-formation fibrin cross-linking that is not detected by routine PT/aPTT testing.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Miller Fisher syndrome is an acute immune-mediated Guillain-Barre-spectrum neuropathy classically characterized by ophthalmoplegia, ataxia, and areflexia and is strongly associated with IgG antibodies against the GQ1b ganglioside.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Miller Fisher syndrome and associate it with anti-GQ1b ganglioside antibodies.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Gain-of-function pathogenic variants in ACVR1/ALK2 cause dysregulated bone morphogenetic protein signaling and progressive heterotopic endochondral ossification of skeletal muscle, fascia, tendons, and ligaments, often triggered by soft-tissue injury.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva to ACVR1 gain-of-function signaling and trauma-triggered heterotopic ossification.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Transthyretin amyloidosis results from destabilization of transthyretin tetramers and extracellular deposition of misfolded transthyretin fibrils; myocardial infiltration increases ventricular wall thickness and stiffness and produces a restrictive cardiomyopathy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis from restrictive cardiac findings plus strong bone-tracer uptake after exclusion of a monoclonal light-chain process.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome is an autosomal dominant hamartomatous polyposis syndrome caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in STK11, a serine/threonine kinase tumor suppressor involved in cell polarity, growth control, and AMPK-related signaling.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Peutz-Jeghers syndrome and associate it with heterozygous STK11 loss of function.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Thyroid peroxidase at the apical follicular-cell membrane uses hydrogen peroxide to oxidize iodide and catalyzes iodination (organification) of tyrosyl residues in thyroglobulin, a required step in thyroid-hormone synthesis; loss-of-function TPO variants impair this process.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link TPO-related congenital hypothyroidism to failure of iodide oxidation and organification onto thyroglobulin.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Most adult Refsum disease is caused by biallelic PHYH variants that impair peroxisomal phytanoyl-CoA hydroxylase, blocking alpha-oxidation of phytanic acid and causing systemic phytanic-acid accumulation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate adult Refsum disease with impaired peroxisomal alpha-oxidation of phytanic acid due most commonly to PHYH deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: In a crossover trial each participant receives multiple interventions in sequence. If the effect of the first intervention persists into the next treatment period, an inadequate washout allows residual treatment effect to contaminate the second-period outcome, producing a carryover effect.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify inadequate washout and persistent treatment effect as the source of carryover bias in a crossover clinical trial.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC22A5 encodes the high-affinity OCTN2 carnitine transporter. Loss of OCTN2 impairs cellular carnitine uptake and renal carnitine reabsorption, causing very low plasma and intracellular carnitine and limiting transport of long-chain fatty acids into mitochondria for beta-oxidation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link primary carnitine deficiency to SLC22A5/OCTN2-mediated failure of cellular carnitine uptake and renal carnitine reabsorption.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Premature adrenarche is an early increase in adrenal zona reticularis secretion of DHEA, DHEAS, and androstenedione. It occurs independently of activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis and can produce pubic/axillary hair and body odor without breast development.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize premature adrenarche as early adrenal zona-reticularis androgen secretion producing isolated pubic-hair/body-odor changes without central gonadarche.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Activated factor XI propagates the intrinsic coagulation pathway by activating factor IX to factor IXa. Factor XI deficiency therefore impairs intrinsic-pathway amplification and can cause variable bleeding after trauma or surgery.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link factor XI deficiency to impaired activation of factor IX within the intrinsic coagulation pathway.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SPAST encodes spastin, an AAA-family ATPase with microtubule-severing activity. SPAST dysfunction disrupts microtubule dynamics in long corticospinal axons and is the most common cause of autosomal dominant uncomplicated hereditary spastic paraplegia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate SPAST-related hereditary spastic paraplegia with loss of spastin-mediated microtubule severing.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: DES encodes desmin, the major muscle-specific cytoplasmic intermediate filament. Desmin links and mechanically integrates myofibrils with the sarcolemma and organelles; pathogenic DES variants can disrupt intermediate-filament assembly and cause skeletal myopathy, cardiomyopathy, and conduction disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize desminopathy as a disease of the muscle intermediate-filament cytoskeleton.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PRKAR1A encodes the regulatory subunit type I-alpha of cAMP-dependent protein kinase A. Loss of this tumor-suppressor regulatory subunit increases PKA signaling and predisposes to cardiac myxomas, lentigines, endocrine tumors/overactivity, and schwannomas.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Carney complex and link PRKAR1A loss of function to increased cAMP-dependent PKA activity.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Leptin is an adipocyte-derived signal of energy stores that acts in the hypothalamus to promote satiety and support neuroendocrine reproductive function. Complete leptin deficiency causes severe early-onset hyperphagia and obesity and can cause hypogonadotropic hypogonadism.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain congenital leptin deficiency as loss of an adipocyte-derived hypothalamic satiety signal.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC6A19 encodes the B0AT1 neutral amino-acid transporter on apical membranes of small-intestinal and proximal-tubular cells. Impaired neutral amino-acid transport causes neutral aminoaciduria and reduced intestinal tryptophan absorption, which can limit niacin synthesis and produce pellagra-like dermatitis and neurologic symptoms.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect SLC6A19-dependent neutral amino-acid transport failure in Hartnup disease to reduced tryptophan availability and secondary niacin deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Biallelic OAT defects cause deficiency of mitochondrial pyridoxal-phosphate-dependent ornithine aminotransferase, impairing ornithine catabolism to pyrroline-5-carboxylate/glutamate-related intermediates and causing marked hyperornithinemia with progressive chorioretinal degeneration.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate OAT deficiency in gyrate atrophy with marked accumulation of ornithine.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: In a Cox proportional-hazards model, the hazard ratio compares instantaneous event hazards between groups among individuals who have remained event-free up to a given time. Under the proportional-hazards assumption, that relative hazard is constant over time; it is not the same as a cumulative risk ratio.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Interpret a Cox-model hazard ratio as a relative instantaneous event hazard rather than a cumulative risk, odds, or survival probability.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Under HHS protections for children in research, an IRB determines whether children are capable of assent and, when assent is required, adequate provisions must be made to obtain it in addition to parental/guardian permission. Parental permission is not itself the child's assent.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply pediatric research-ethics requirements by distinguishing parental permission from a capable child's required assent.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ATP6V1B1 encodes the kidney B1 subunit of the V-type H+-ATPase. Loss of this proton-pump subunit impairs hydrogen-ion secretion by alpha-intercalated cells in the connecting tubule and collecting duct, causing distal renal tubular acidosis and often sensorineural hearing loss.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link ATP6V1B1-related distal renal tubular acidosis to impaired V-type H+-ATPase–mediated distal hydrogen-ion secretion.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome is a disorder of lysosome-related organelle biogenesis that causes oculocutaneous albinism and a platelet storage-pool defect with absent platelet delta (dense) granules; PT, PTT, and platelet count are typically normal.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome from the combination of albinism, mucocutaneous bleeding, and absent platelet dense bodies.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: HNPP is usually caused by a recurrent deletion involving PMP22 that reduces PMP22 dosage. PMP22 haploinsufficiency disrupts peripheral myelin and predisposes to recurrent focal neuropathies after compression or minor trauma.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate HNPP with reduced PMP22 gene dosage and haploinsufficiency.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Camurati-Engelmann disease is caused by heterozygous pathogenic variants in TGFB1. Many variants disrupt latency-associated peptide interactions and increase active TGF-beta1 signaling; the disease mechanism is gain of function and produces progressive diaphyseal hyperostosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate Camurati-Engelmann disease with gain of TGFB1 signaling and progressive diaphyseal hyperostosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Danon disease is an X-linked LAMP2-related multisystem disorder in which males commonly develop severe childhood-onset hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and conduction abnormalities together with skeletal myopathy and mild intellectual disability.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Danon disease from early hypertrophic cardiomyopathy/conduction disease plus skeletal myopathy and cognitive involvement in an X-linked pattern.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ABCB11 encodes the bile salt export pump (BSEP), an ATP-binding cassette transporter on the canalicular membrane of hepatocytes that mediates biliary bile-acid export. BSEP deficiency causes PFIC2 with cholestasis and typically low or normal GGT.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link ABCB11-related PFIC2 to impaired canalicular bile-salt export by BSEP.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Activating KCNJ11 variants reduce ATP inhibition of the Kir6.2-containing beta-cell KATP channel. The channel remains excessively open despite glucose metabolism, maintaining membrane hyperpolarization and suppressing voltage-gated calcium influx and glucose-stimulated insulin secretion.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain KCNJ11-related neonatal diabetes through failure of ATP-dependent closure of the Kir6.2-containing beta-cell KATP channel.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PMM2 encodes phosphomannomutase 2, which converts mannose-6-phosphate to mannose-1-phosphate. Loss of PMM2 lowers the mannose-1-phosphate/GDP-mannose pool and impairs synthesis of lipid-linked oligosaccharides required for N-linked protein glycosylation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link PMM2-CDG to impaired conversion of mannose-6-phosphate to mannose-1-phosphate and deficient N-linked glycosylation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Bland-Altman analysis evaluates agreement between two quantitative measurement methods by plotting each paired difference against the pair's mean and estimating mean bias and limits of agreement. A high correlation coefficient alone does not establish agreement.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Choose Bland-Altman analysis when evaluating agreement between two quantitative clinical measurement methods.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cross-monitoring is a TeamSTEPPS situation-monitoring strategy in which team members actively observe one another's actions and provide a safety net by detecting and correcting mistakes or oversights early.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize TeamSTEPPS cross-monitoring as observing teammates' actions to detect and correct errors early.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Claudin-16 is a tight-junction protein in the thick ascending limb that participates with claudin-19 in paracellular reabsorption of magnesium and calcium. CLDN16 loss causes renal magnesium wasting, hypercalciuria, nephrocalcinosis, and progressive kidney disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link CLDN16-related familial hypomagnesemia with hypercalciuria and nephrocalcinosis to defective paracellular divalent-cation reabsorption in the thick ascending limb.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Biallelic NBEAL2 variants impair platelet alpha-granule biogenesis. Platelets are often large, pale or gray on light microscopy, with alpha-granule deficiency and variable thrombocytopenia and bleeding.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize NBEAL2-related gray platelet syndrome from macrothrombocytopenia, gray platelets, and alpha-granule deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: NTRK1 encodes TrkA, the high-affinity receptor tyrosine kinase for nerve growth factor. Loss of NGF-TrkA signaling disrupts development and survival of nociceptive sensory and sympathetic neurons, causing profound loss of pain/temperature sensation and anhidrosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate NTRK1-related congenital insensitivity to pain with anhidrosis with loss of NGF-TrkA signaling.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Maffucci syndrome combines multiple enchondromas with vascular lesions and is associated with somatic mosaic IDH1 or IDH2 mutations. Mutant IDH acquires neomorphic activity that reduces alpha-ketoglutarate to the oncometabolite 2-hydroxyglutarate, altering cellular differentiation and epigenetic regulation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link Maffucci syndrome to mosaic mutant IDH activity and production of the oncometabolite 2-hydroxyglutarate.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PRKAG2 variants affect the gamma-2 regulatory subunit of AMP-activated protein kinase and produce a glycogen-storage cardiomyopathy characterized by ventricular preexcitation, cardiac hypertrophy, and progressive conduction-system disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize PRKAG2 cardiac syndrome from autosomal dominant hypertrophic cardiomyopathy with ventricular preexcitation and conduction-system disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: TMPRSS15 encodes enteropeptidase (enterokinase), a brush-border serine protease of the proximal small intestine. Enteropeptidase initiates pancreatic protease activation by cleaving trypsinogen to active trypsin; trypsin then activates additional pancreatic zymogens.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link TMPRSS15-related enteropeptidase deficiency to failure of brush-border trypsinogen activation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss-of-function variants in IGSF1 cause an X-linked syndrome whose characteristic endocrine phenotype includes central hypothyroidism and macroorchidism; hypoprolactinemia, delayed pubertal testosterone rise, obesity, and attention problems can also occur.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize IGSF1 deficiency syndrome from X-linked central hypothyroidism with macroorchidism and associated pituitary abnormalities.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC7A7 encodes y+LAT1, a basolateral cationic amino-acid transporter expressed in renal and intestinal epithelial cells. Loss impairs transport of lysine, arginine, and ornithine, causing low plasma concentrations, increased urinary excretion, and postprandial hyperammonemia after protein intake.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link SLC7A7-related lysinuric protein intolerance to defective basolateral epithelial transport of cationic amino acids.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cohen kappa quantifies agreement between two raters for categorical outcomes after accounting for agreement expected by chance. Raw percent agreement does not correct for chance agreement.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Choose Cohen kappa for chance-corrected agreement between two raters classifying the same observations categorically.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: NURSE is a communication framework for responding to emotion: Name the emotion, express Understanding, show Respect, offer Support, and Explore the patient's concerns.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize NURSE statements as a structured framework for responding empathically to patient emotion.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: APRT is a cytoplasmic purine-salvage enzyme that uses adenine and phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate to synthesize AMP. APRT loss diverts adenine toward oxidation to poorly soluble 2,8-dihydroxyadenine, causing radiolucent kidney stones and crystal nephropathy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link APRT deficiency to loss of adenine salvage into AMP and formation of 2,8-dihydroxyadenine stones.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Germline heterozygous pathogenic variants in RUNX1 cause an autosomal dominant disorder characterized by variable quantitative or qualitative platelet abnormalities and a substantially increased lifetime risk of myelodysplastic syndrome and acute myeloid leukemia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize RUNX1 familial platelet disorder from autosomal dominant bleeding/platelet abnormalities plus familial myeloid malignancy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: eIF2B is a five-subunit guanine nucleotide exchange factor that converts eIF2-GDP to eIF2-GTP, permitting translation initiation. Biallelic EIF2B-pathway loss-of-function variants impair eIF2B activity and cellular stress responses, producing vanishing white matter disease with episodes of rapid neurologic deterioration after fever, infection, or minor head trauma.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link EIF2B-related vanishing white matter disease to impaired eIF2 GDP-to-GTP guanine nucleotide exchange during translation initiation.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Buschke-Ollendorff syndrome is an autosomal dominant disorder caused by loss-of-function variants in LEMD3 and classically combines connective-tissue nevi with osteopoikilosis, a pattern of multiple small sclerotic bone foci.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize LEMD3-related Buschke-Ollendorff syndrome from connective-tissue nevi plus osteopoikilosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Desmoplakin is a desmosomal structural protein that anchors intermediate filaments to the desmosomal plaque, enabling mechanical coupling between cardiomyocytes. DSP variants can cause a left-dominant arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy with myocardial fibrosis, ventricular arrhythmias, and episodic myocardial injury.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link DSP cardiomyopathy to loss of desmoplakin-mediated anchoring of intermediate filaments at cardiac desmosomes.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: DGAT1 is an acyl-CoA:diacylglycerol acyltransferase highly expressed in human enterocytes that catalyzes the final step of triglyceride synthesis by adding a fatty acyl-CoA to diacylglycerol. Biallelic DGAT1 loss can cause severe early-onset diarrhea and protein-losing enteropathy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link DGAT1 deficiency to failure of the final diacylglycerol-to-triacylglycerol step of triglyceride synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: NR3C2 encodes the mineralocorticoid receptor. Heterozygous loss-of-function variants cause renal pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1, in which the kidney is resistant to aldosterone, producing salt wasting, hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, metabolic acidosis, and compensatory elevation of renin and aldosterone.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize NR3C2-related renal pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1 as high-renin, high-aldosterone neonatal salt wasting from mineralocorticoid receptor resistance.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: GNPTAB encodes the alpha and beta subunits of N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphotransferase, which initiates synthesis of the mannose-6-phosphate recognition marker on lysosomal hydrolases in the Golgi. Severe loss causes mucolipidosis II alpha/beta with failure of lysosomal enzyme targeting and extracellular mis-secretion of hydrolases.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link mucolipidosis II alpha/beta to defective GNPTAB-dependent mannose-6-phosphate tagging of lysosomal hydrolases.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Classical random measurement error in a continuous exposure variable attenuates the estimated exposure-outcome association toward the null in simple regression, a phenomenon known as regression dilution or attenuation bias.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize regression dilution bias as attenuation toward the null from random measurement error in a continuous exposure.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Best Case/Worst Case is a scenario-planning communication tool that compares treatment options by describing a range of plausible trajectories for each option, including the best case, worst case, and most likely outcome, to support preference-sensitive shared decision making.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Best Case/Worst Case as a scenario-based shared-decision framework for high-stakes treatment choices.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC4A4 encodes NBCe1-A, the electrogenic sodium-bicarbonate cotransporter on the basolateral membrane of proximal tubular cells. Loss impairs basolateral Na+/HCO3- exit and therefore transepithelial bicarbonate reabsorption, causing autosomal recessive proximal renal tubular acidosis often accompanied by ocular abnormalities.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link SLC4A4-related proximal RTA to defective basolateral NBCe1-mediated sodium-bicarbonate cotransport in proximal tubular cells.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PAI-1, encoded by SERPINE1, inhibits tissue-type and urokinase-type plasminogen activators. Complete deficiency causes excessive conversion of plasminogen to plasmin and excessive fibrinolysis, producing delayed bleeding after trauma or surgery despite normal routine coagulation tests.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link complete PAI-1 deficiency to excessive fibrinolysis caused by failure to inhibit plasminogen activators.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: GAN encodes gigaxonin, a BTB-Kelch protein that controls turnover of specific proteins by targeting them for proteasomal degradation. Loss of gigaxonin causes accumulation of cytoskeletal intermediate filaments, including neurofilaments, producing giant axons and progressive neurodegeneration.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link GAN-related neurodegeneration to failure of gigaxonin-mediated turnover of intermediate-filament proteins.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Jansen metaphyseal chondrodysplasia is caused by gain-of-function PTH1R variants that constitutively activate the PTH/PTHrP receptor in a ligand-independent manner, producing skeletal dysplasia and PTH-like mineral-ion effects despite suppressed endogenous PTH.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate Jansen metaphyseal chondrodysplasia with constitutive ligand-independent PTH1R activation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ALPK3 is an atypical cardiac pseudokinase that functions as a scaffold at the sarcomeric M-band and nuclear envelope. Loss disrupts localization of myomesins and other M-band proteins and impairs sarcomeric proteostasis, producing hypertrophic or dilated cardiomyopathy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link ALPK3 cardiomyopathy to loss of M-band scaffolding and sarcomeric proteostasis rather than kinase catalysis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MYO5B encodes myosin Vb, an actin-based motor/tether that cooperates with Rab8/Rab11 recycling pathways to deliver and recycle apical cargo in polarized enterocytes. Loss disrupts apical membrane trafficking and brush-border protein localization, causing severe congenital diarrhea and characteristic microvillus inclusions.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link MYO5B-related microvillus inclusion disease to defective Rab-dependent apical membrane trafficking and recycling in enterocytes.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: HSD11B2 encodes renal 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2, which converts active cortisol to inactive cortisone in mineralocorticoid target cells. Loss permits cortisol to activate mineralocorticoid receptors, causing sodium retention, hypertension, hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis, and suppression of both renin and aldosterone.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link apparent mineralocorticoid excess to loss of HSD11B2-mediated conversion of cortisol to cortisone in renal mineralocorticoid target cells.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC25A15 encodes ORNT1, the mitochondrial ornithine transporter that moves cytosolic ornithine into the mitochondrial matrix. Loss deprives the urea cycle of intramitochondrial ornithine, causing hyperammonemia, hyperornithinemia, and homocitrullinuria.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link HHH syndrome to defective mitochondrial ornithine import through SLC25A15/ORNT1.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Neyman bias occurs when a case-control study samples prevalent rather than incident cases and exposure affects both disease occurrence and disease-related survival. Cases who die or recover before sampling are missed, so the exposure distribution among observed cases is distorted.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Neyman prevalence-incidence bias when prevalent-case sampling selectively excludes rapidly fatal exposed cases.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: VALUE is a structured family-conference communication strategy: Value family statements, Acknowledge emotions, Listen, Understand the patient as a person, and Elicit family questions.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize VALUE as a structured communication strategy for ICU family conferences.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC5A2 encodes SGLT2, the high-capacity sodium-glucose cotransporter on the apical brush-border membrane of early proximal tubular cells. Loss reduces reabsorption of filtered glucose despite normal plasma glucose.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link familial renal glucosuria to impaired apical SGLT2-mediated sodium-glucose cotransport in the early proximal tubule.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ANO6 encodes TMEM16F, a calcium-activated phospholipid scramblase. Upon strong platelet activation it externalizes phosphatidylserine, providing an anionic membrane surface for tenase and prothrombinase assembly and efficient thrombin generation. Loss causes Scott syndrome.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link Scott syndrome to defective ANO6/TMEM16F-mediated phosphatidylserine externalization on activated platelets.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: KIF1A is an ATP-dependent kinesin motor that transports neuronal cargo along axonal microtubules. Disease-causing variants commonly disrupt the motor domain and reduce microtubule-based cargo transport.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate KIF1A-related neurologic disease with impaired ATP-dependent axonal microtubule cargo transport.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: AMER1 acts as an inhibitor of canonical WNT signaling by promoting beta-catenin ubiquitination and degradation. Loss of AMER1 causes nuclear beta-catenin accumulation, increased WNT signaling and osteoblastic activity, producing cranial sclerosis and metaphyseal striations.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link AMER1 loss to increased beta-catenin/canonical WNT signaling in osteopathia striata with cranial sclerosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: RBM20 is a cardiac RNA-binding splicing regulator whose major targets include TTN and other sarcomeric/ion-handling transcripts. Pathogenic RBM20 dysfunction alters titin isoform splicing and can cause aggressive familial dilated cardiomyopathy with arrhythmias.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link RBM20 cardiomyopathy to abnormal alternative splicing of TTN and other cardiac transcripts.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Biallelic SPINT2 loss causes syndromic congenital sodium diarrhea, a severe neonatal sodium-rich secretory diarrhea associated with extraintestinal anomalies such as choanal or anal atresia and corneal disease; SPINT2 encodes a Kunitz-type serine-protease inhibitor.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize SPINT2-related syndromic congenital sodium diarrhea from neonatal sodium-rich diarrhea plus characteristic extraintestinal anomalies.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: KISS1R is the kisspeptin receptor expressed on GnRH neurons. Kisspeptin activation of KISS1R depolarizes GnRH neurons and stimulates GnRH secretion; inactivating KISS1R variants can cause normosmic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism and failure of normal pubertal activation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link KISS1R-related hypogonadotropic hypogonadism to loss of kisspeptin stimulation of hypothalamic GnRH neurons.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MOCS1 participates in the first step of molybdenum cofactor biosynthesis, converting GTP to cyclic pyranopterin monophosphate. Loss of molybdenum cofactor disables sulfite oxidase and other molybdoenzymes; sulfite accumulation is the major driver of severe neonatal neurotoxicity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link MOCS1-related molybdenum cofactor deficiency to impaired sulfite oxidation and neurotoxic sulfite accumulation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The ecological fallacy occurs when an association observed using aggregate group-level data is incorrectly assumed to hold at the individual level; group-level joint distributions do not establish individual-level exposure-outcome relationships.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize ecological fallacy when group-level associations are incorrectly generalized to individuals.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The Four Habits Model organizes an outpatient clinical encounter into four communication tasks: Invest in the beginning, Elicit the patient's perspective, Demonstrate empathy, and Invest in the end.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the Four Habits Model from its four sequential physician communication tasks across a clinical encounter.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Inhibition of apical NKCC2 in the thick ascending limb reduces NaCl accumulation in the medullary interstitium, weakens the corticomedullary osmotic gradient, and impairs maximal urinary concentration.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain why loop-diuretic blockade of NKCC2 decreases the medullary osmotic gradient and limits maximal urinary concentration.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Carbonic anhydrase inhibition in the proximal tubule decreases bicarbonate reclamation, causing bicarbonaturia, alkaline urine initially, and a hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link acetazolamide to inhibition of proximal tubular carbonic anhydrase and bicarbonate reabsorption.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Small pulmonary arteries supplying hypoxic alveoli constrict, diverting perfusion toward better-ventilated lung regions and improving regional ventilation-perfusion matching.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Contrast the pulmonary vascular response to alveolar hypoxia with systemic vascular responses and explain its role in V/Q matching.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Surfactant deficiency increases alveolar surface tension; by Laplace's relationship, small alveoli require greater distending pressure and are prone to collapse, lowering lung compliance and causing diffuse atelectasis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply Laplace's law to explain alveolar instability and reduced compliance in neonatal respiratory distress syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduced thyroid-hormone receptor beta signaling impairs feedback suppression of pituitary TSH despite elevated circulating free T4 and T3, producing elevated thyroid hormones with a nonsuppressed TSH.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize resistance to thyroid hormone beta from elevated free thyroid hormones with nonsuppressed TSH and a familial pattern.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Aromatase normally converts androgen precursors to estrogens in the fetal-placental unit; deficiency causes androgen accumulation, which can virilize a 46,XX fetus and the mother during pregnancy.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify aromatase deficiency as failure of androgen-to-estrogen conversion causing maternal and 46,XX fetal virilization.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Warfarin rapidly lowers the vitamin K–dependent natural anticoagulant protein C, which has a relatively short half-life, before full depletion of procoagulant factors; the resulting transient hypercoagulable state can cause dermal microvascular thrombosis and skin necrosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain warfarin-induced skin necrosis as transient early hypercoagulability caused by rapid depletion of protein C.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: A lesion of the medial longitudinal fasciculus interrupts the internuclear projection from the contralateral abducens nucleus to the ipsilateral oculomotor medial-rectus subnucleus, causing ipsilateral adduction weakness with contralateral abducting nystagmus.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Localize internuclear ophthalmoplegia to the ipsilateral medial longitudinal fasciculus based on horizontal-gaze findings.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Nitrogen-containing bisphosphonates inhibit farnesyl pyrophosphate/diphosphate synthase in the mevalonate pathway, impairing prenylation of small GTP-binding proteins required for osteoclast function and survival.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify farnesyl pyrophosphate synthase inhibition as the key intracellular mechanism of nitrogen-containing bisphosphonates.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Lithium enters collecting-duct principal cells through apical ENaC and disrupts vasopressin-responsive water transport, including downregulation of AQP2; amiloride limits toxicity by blocking ENaC-mediated lithium entry.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain why amiloride is useful in lithium-induced nephrogenic diabetes insipidus by blocking ENaC-mediated lithium entry into collecting-duct principal cells.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Digoxin inhibits myocardial Na+/K+ ATPase, increasing intracellular Na+ and thereby decreasing Na+/Ca2+ exchanger-mediated Ca2+ extrusion; intracellular and sarcoplasmic-reticulum Ca2+ increase, augmenting contractility.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain digoxin's positive inotropic effect through Na+/K+ ATPase inhibition and secondary reduction of Na+/Ca2+ exchanger-mediated Ca2+ extrusion.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Organophosphates phosphorylate acetylcholinesterase. Subsequent dealkylation ('aging') strengthens the enzyme-organophosphate bond so that pralidoxime can no longer reactivate acetylcholinesterase.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the time dependence of pralidoxime therapy in organophosphate poisoning by the aging of phosphorylated acetylcholinesterase.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Carbon monoxide forms carboxyhemoglobin, reducing hemoglobin oxygen-carrying capacity and increasing the oxygen affinity of remaining unoccupied heme sites, producing a left shift in the oxyhemoglobin dissociation curve while dissolved arterial oxygen tension may remain normal.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate arterial oxygen tension from blood oxygen content and explain carbon monoxide-induced tissue hypoxia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Spironolactone is a nonselective mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist that also antagonizes androgen signaling; its antiandrogen effects can cause gynecomastia and sexual adverse effects, whereas eplerenone is more selective.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate spironolactone-associated gynecomastia to its nonselective steroid-receptor profile and antiandrogen activity.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Hydroxyurea increases the proportion of fetal hemoglobin (HbF). HbF reduces the effective concentration and polymerization of deoxygenated HbS, decreasing erythrocyte sickling and vaso-occlusive events.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain how increased fetal hemoglobin reduces HbS polymerization and vaso-occlusive complications during hydroxyurea therapy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Methotrexate inhibits dihydrofolate reductase. Leucovorin is a reduced folate that does not require DHFR-mediated activation and restores reduced folate pools needed for purine and thymidylate synthesis in normal tissues.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain leucovorin rescue as bypass of methotrexate-induced dihydrofolate reductase inhibition.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acute arterial pressure reduction decreases stretch and firing of carotid sinus and aortic arch baroreceptors, reducing afferent inhibitory input to the medulla and increasing sympathetic while decreasing parasympathetic output.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Trace the immediate baroreceptor reflex response to acute hemorrhage from reduced arterial stretch to autonomic compensation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acute hyperventilation lowers PaCO2, causing cerebral arteriolar vasoconstriction and reducing cerebral blood flow and cerebral blood volume, which can transiently lower intracranial pressure.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the temporary effect of hyperventilation on intracranial pressure through carbon dioxide-dependent cerebral vasoconstriction.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Naloxone is a competitive opioid receptor antagonist with greatest affinity for the mu receptor, rapidly reversing opioid-induced respiratory depression and CNS effects.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify competitive mu-opioid receptor antagonism as the mechanism of naloxone in opioid overdose.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cyanide binds metal centers in cytochrome c oxidase (electron transport chain complex IV), preventing electron transfer to oxygen, halting oxidative phosphorylation, and forcing anaerobic metabolism with severe lactic acidosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify cytochrome c oxidase (complex IV) as the mitochondrial target of cyanide and link its inhibition to histotoxic hypoxia and lactic acidosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Heavy glomerular protein loss can lower circulating antithrombin and other anticoagulant proteins, shifting hemostasis toward thrombosis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link nephrotic-range protein loss to acquired antithrombin deficiency and venous thrombosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Unfractionated heparin binds antithrombin, causing a conformational change that markedly accelerates antithrombin-mediated inactivation of thrombin and factor Xa.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain unfractionated heparin anticoagulation through potentiation of antithrombin.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Competitive inhibition of HMG-CoA reductase lowers hepatic cholesterol synthesis, leading hepatocytes to upregulate LDL receptors and increase clearance of circulating LDL.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate HMG-CoA reductase inhibition to compensatory hepatic LDL receptor upregulation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: An acute fall in PaCO2 raises pH immediately; renal reduction of bicarbonate reabsorption and generation develops more slowly over hours to days.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate the rapid primary/chemical effects of hyperventilation from delayed renal compensation in respiratory alkalosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Beta2 adrenergic stimulation increases membrane Na+/K+ ATPase activity in peripheral tissues, shifting potassium from extracellular fluid into cells.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain beta2-agonist-associated hypokalemia as transcellular potassium redistribution.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acetaminophen overdose increases formation of the reactive metabolite NAPQI after normal conjugation pathways are overwhelmed. Glutathione depletion permits NAPQI-mediated hepatocyte injury; N-acetylcysteine replenishes glutathione and helps detoxify NAPQI.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain N-acetylcysteine treatment of acetaminophen overdose through restoration of glutathione-dependent NAPQI detoxification.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Aspirin irreversibly acetylates platelet cyclooxygenase-1, reducing thromboxane A2 synthesis. Because mature platelets lack nuclei, they cannot synthesize new COX enzyme, so the effect persists for the lifespan of the exposed platelets.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link aspirin's irreversible COX inhibition to the anucleate biology of platelets and the prolonged antiplatelet effect.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Excess ADH initially increases free-water reabsorption, but mild extracellular-volume expansion triggers renal natriuresis. Continued sodium loss with water retention produces dilutional hyponatremia without sustained clinical edema or marked hypervolemia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain why SIADH usually produces euvolemic hyponatremia despite persistent ADH-mediated water reabsorption.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Destruction of alveolar walls reduces elastic recoil and radial traction on small airways, promoting dynamic airway collapse during expiration and causing air trapping and hyperinflation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate alveolar wall destruction in emphysema to loss of elastic recoil and expiratory small-airway collapse.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: When renal perfusion is reduced, angiotensin II constricts efferent arterioles to support glomerular capillary pressure. ACE inhibition removes this compensatory efferent constriction, lowering intraglomerular pressure and GFR.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the fall in GFR after ACE inhibition in bilateral renal artery stenosis through loss of angiotensin II-mediated efferent arteriolar constriction.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Renal prostaglandins normally support afferent arteriolar dilation, particularly when effective circulating volume is reduced. Cyclooxygenase inhibition lowers prostaglandin synthesis, causing relative afferent vasoconstriction and reduced glomerular capillary pressure.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain NSAID-associated acute kidney injury through loss of prostaglandin-mediated afferent arteriolar dilation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Insulin deficiency and hyperosmolality shift potassium out of cells, which may raise serum potassium, while osmotic diuresis, vomiting, and secondary renal losses cause a substantial total-body potassium deficit.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish serum potassium concentration from total-body potassium stores in diabetic ketoacidosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Parathyroid hormone decreases proximal tubular phosphate reabsorption by promoting internalization of apical sodium-phosphate cotransporters, especially NaPi-IIa and NaPi-IIc, causing phosphaturia.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain PTH-induced hypophosphatemia through proximal tubular sodium-phosphate cotransporter internalization.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Beta1 adrenergic receptors on juxtaglomerular cells promote renin release. Selective beta1 blockade decreases renin secretion, reducing downstream angiotensin II and aldosterone activity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate beta1 receptor blockade on juxtaglomerular cells to reduced renin release.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Glucocorticoids reduce neutrophil adhesion to endothelium and promote demargination from the vascular marginal pool, increasing circulating neutrophil counts despite suppression of inflammatory recruitment into tissues.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain glucocorticoid-associated neutrophilia through neutrophil demargination.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Epinephrine stimulates alpha1 receptors on vascular smooth muscle, causing vasoconstriction that raises systemic vascular resistance and helps reverse distributive hypotension and mucosal edema during anaphylaxis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify alpha1 adrenergic vasoconstriction as the epinephrine effect that most directly reverses anaphylactic hypotension.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: During sensitization, IgE binds high-affinity Fc epsilon RI receptors on mast cells. On re-exposure, multivalent allergen cross-links receptor-bound IgE, triggering mast-cell activation and rapid mediator release.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the immediate phase of type I hypersensitivity through allergen-mediated cross-linking of mast-cell-bound IgE.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: C5a is a potent complement-derived neutrophil chemoattractant and anaphylatoxin generated during complement activation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify C5a as the complement fragment responsible for potent neutrophil chemotaxis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acute bacterial meningitis typically produces elevated opening pressure, neutrophilic pleocytosis, elevated CSF protein, and reduced CSF glucose relative to serum.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the characteristic cerebrospinal fluid profile of acute bacterial meningitis.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Rifampin is a potent inducer of drug-metabolizing enzymes, particularly CYP3A4, and transport proteins such as P-glycoprotein, increasing clearance of many concurrently administered drugs including hormonal contraceptives.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain rifampin-associated drug interactions through hepatic cytochrome P450 induction.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: At supratherapeutic concentrations, metformin inhibits mitochondrial respiratory-chain complex I, impairing oxidative phosphorylation and promoting lactate accumulation, especially when renal clearance is reduced.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify mitochondrial complex I inhibition as a central biochemical mechanism of metformin-associated lactic acidosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Vancomycin binds the D-alanyl-D-alanine terminus of peptidoglycan precursors, sterically inhibiting cell-wall polymerization and cross-linking in susceptible gram-positive bacteria.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify D-Ala-D-Ala as the direct molecular binding target of vancomycin.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Aminoglycosides bind the bacterial 30S ribosomal subunit near the 16S rRNA A site, causing misreading of the genetic code and disruption of protein synthesis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize 30S binding with mRNA misreading as the characteristic aminoglycoside mechanism.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Macrolides bind the bacterial 50S ribosomal subunit and inhibit elongation/translocation of the growing peptide, suppressing protein synthesis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify inhibition of 50S ribosomal translocation as the core macrolide mechanism.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Sulfamethoxazole inhibits dihydropteroate synthase by competing with PABA, while trimethoprim inhibits bacterial dihydrofolate reductase, producing sequential inhibition of tetrahydrofolate synthesis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the synergistic antimicrobial effect of TMP-SMX through sequential inhibition of bacterial folate synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chronic glucocorticoid exposure reduces osteoblast activity and lifespan, promotes osteoblast/osteocyte apoptosis, and shifts remodeling toward net bone loss.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify impaired osteoblast function and survival as a major mechanism of glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: IgG autoantibodies against postsynaptic nicotinic acetylcholine receptors block receptor function, promote receptor internalization, and activate complement, reducing functional receptor density at the motor end plate.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate AChR autoantibodies to loss of functional postsynaptic receptors and fatigable weakness in myasthenia gravis.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Botulinum neurotoxin is a zinc-dependent protease that cleaves SNARE proteins in cholinergic nerve terminals, preventing synaptic-vesicle fusion and acetylcholine release.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify SNARE cleavage with impaired presynaptic acetylcholine release as the mechanism of botulinum toxin.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Tetanospasmin reaches inhibitory interneurons by retrograde axonal transport and prevents release of GABA and glycine, removing inhibitory control of motor neurons and causing spasticity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain tetanus spasticity through loss of GABA and glycine release from inhibitory interneurons.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: NKCC2 blockade reduces ROMK-dependent potassium recycling and the lumen-positive transepithelial voltage in the thick ascending limb, decreasing paracellular calcium and magnesium reabsorption.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain loop-diuretic-induced calciuria and magnesiuria through loss of the lumen-positive voltage in the thick ascending limb.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ACE (kininase II) degrades bradykinin. ACE inhibition increases pulmonary bradykinin/kinin signaling, contributing to a persistent nonproductive cough.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain ACE-inhibitor-associated cough through impaired bradykinin degradation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Class IB lidocaine binds preferentially to open/inactivated voltage-gated sodium channels and is therefore especially effective in rapidly depolarizing or ischemic ventricular tissue, where more sodium channels occupy inactivated states.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate lidocaine's class IB antiarrhythmic selectivity to preferential binding of open/inactivated sodium channels.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Adenosine activates A1 receptors in AV nodal tissue, increasing potassium conductance and decreasing calcium-dependent nodal depolarization, transiently slowing or blocking AV conduction.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain adenosine's rapid termination of AV node-dependent SVT through A1-mediated hyperpolarization and reduced calcium current.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Insulin rapidly lowers serum potassium by stimulating cellular potassium uptake, in large part through increased Na+/K+ ATPase activity, without removing potassium from the body.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish insulin-mediated transcellular potassium redistribution from definitive potassium elimination in hyperkalemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Mannitol is freely filtered and poorly reabsorbed, increasing tubular fluid osmolality and reducing passive water reabsorption, thereby increasing urinary water excretion.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain mannitol-induced diuresis through increased tubular fluid osmolality from a filtered, poorly reabsorbed solute.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Isoniazid is a prodrug activated by mycobacterial KatG catalase-peroxidase. Reactive intermediates inhibit enzymes involved in mycolic acid synthesis, impairing the mycobacterial cell wall.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify KatG-activated inhibition of mycolic acid synthesis as the core mechanism of isoniazid.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Fluoroquinolones inhibit bacterial DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV by stabilizing enzyme-DNA cleavage complexes, producing lethal double-stranded DNA breaks.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV as the principal molecular targets of fluoroquinolones.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Beta-lactam antibiotics acylate penicillin-binding proteins, including DD-transpeptidases, preventing the terminal transpeptidation step that cross-links peptidoglycan.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain beta-lactam bactericidal activity through inhibition of PBP-mediated peptidoglycan transpeptidation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Linezolid binds 23S rRNA on the 50S ribosomal subunit and prevents formation of a functional 70S initiation complex.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify inhibition of 70S initiation-complex formation as the characteristic mechanism of linezolid.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: H pylori urease hydrolyzes urea to ammonia and carbon dioxide; ammonia buffers protons and raises local pH, creating a relatively protected microenvironment around the organism.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain H pylori gastric survival through urease-mediated ammonia production and local acid buffering.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Vitamin C is required for prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases during intracellular collagen processing; deficiency produces unstable collagen and reduced tensile strength.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link scurvy to impaired vitamin C-dependent proline/lysine hydroxylation during collagen synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduced vitamin K is a cofactor for gamma-glutamyl carboxylase, which converts glutamate residues to gamma-carboxyglutamate so vitamin K-dependent clotting proteins can bind calcium.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain why vitamin K deficiency impairs coagulation through loss of gamma-carboxylation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The recurrent laryngeal nerve courses near the thyroid in the tracheoesophageal groove and supplies all intrinsic laryngeal muscles except the cricothyroid.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify recurrent laryngeal nerve injury as the cause of postoperative vocal cord paralysis after thyroid surgery.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Long thoracic nerve injury paralyzes serratus anterior, impairing scapular protraction and fixation to the thoracic wall and causing medial winging accentuated by wall pushing.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize long thoracic nerve injury from the classic serratus anterior palsy examination.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Incomplete obliteration of the vitelline (omphalomesenteric) duct leaves a true diverticulum on the antimesenteric ileum.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify persistent vitelline duct as the embryologic basis of Meckel diverticulum.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: 22q11.2/TBX1 haploinsufficiency disrupts pharyngeal apparatus development and cardiac neural crest migration, producing thymic/parathyroid hypoplasia and conotruncal defects.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect thymic hypoplasia, hypocalcemia, and conotruncal disease to 22q11.2-related pharyngeal apparatus defects.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Mutations in COL4A3/4/5 disrupt the type IV collagen alpha345 network in glomerular, cochlear, and ocular basement membranes.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize type IV collagen defects as the molecular basis of Alport syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: IgG antibodies against desmoglein 3 and often desmoglein 1 disrupt desmosomal keratinocyte adhesion, causing intraepidermal acantholysis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link pemphigus vulgaris to autoantibody-mediated disruption of desmosomal desmogleins.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: UCP1 dissipates the mitochondrial proton gradient as heat instead of coupling proton reentry to ATP synthesis, enabling sympathetic cold-induced thermogenesis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain neonatal nonshivering thermogenesis through UCP1-mediated mitochondrial uncoupling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: The left gastric artery, a direct branch of the celiac trunk, runs along the superior lesser curvature and anastomoses with the right gastric artery.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the left gastric artery from its origin and course along the stomach's lesser curvature.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Ventriculomegaly with altered CSF dynamics and periventricular white-matter dysfunction preferentially affects gait/frontal circuits and bladder-control pathways, producing a characteristic progressive triad.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus from its clinicoradiologic gait-cognition-bladder syndrome.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Granulomatous inflammation of medium and large arteries, often cranial branches of the carotid, causes luminal narrowing and ischemic complications including jaw claudication and visual loss.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize giant cell arteritis from the classic cranial ischemic and inflammatory presentation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Most local anesthetics are weak bases. Acidic tissue shifts the drug toward the protonated ionized form, reducing the nonionized lipid-soluble fraction available to cross neuronal membranes and reach intracellular sodium-channel binding sites.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain reduced local-anesthetic efficacy in infected tissue using weak-base ionization and membrane permeability.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Succinylcholine activates postsynaptic nicotinic acetylcholine receptors and maintains end-plate depolarization, inactivating nearby voltage-gated sodium channels and preventing generation of additional action potentials.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain phase I succinylcholine paralysis through persistent end-plate depolarization and sodium-channel inactivation.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Chronic acid reflux promotes metaplastic replacement of normal distal esophageal stratified squamous epithelium by columnar epithelium with intestinal-type goblet cells, increasing adenocarcinoma risk.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Barrett esophagus from chronic GERD plus intestinal-type goblet-cell metaplasia in the distal esophagus.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Common HFE-associated hereditary hemochromatosis lowers hepcidin signaling, leaving ferroportin active on enterocytes and macrophages and increasing dietary iron absorption and iron release into plasma.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain HFE-related hereditary hemochromatosis through reduced hepcidin and persistent ferroportin activity.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Loss of cortisol feedback increases CRH and POMC-derived ACTH production; increased ACTH/MSH-related melanocortin signaling stimulates melanocytes and causes diffuse hyperpigmentation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain hyperpigmentation in primary adrenal insufficiency through increased ACTH/POMC-derived melanocortin signaling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Thyroid-stimulating immunoglobulins bind and activate the TSH receptor, stimulating thyroid hormone synthesis and thyroid growth despite suppressed pituitary TSH.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify stimulatory TSH-receptor autoantibodies as the mechanism of Graves hyperthyroidism.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Warm-reactive IgG coats RBCs at body temperature; splenic macrophages recognize Fc-coated cells, remove membrane, form spherocytes, and mediate predominantly extravascular hemolysis.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain warm AIHA as IgG-mediated splenic extravascular hemolysis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Benzodiazepines bind an allosteric site on GABA-A receptors and, in the presence of GABA, increase the frequency of chloride-channel opening, enhancing postsynaptic hyperpolarization.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish benzodiazepine GABA-A modulation from barbiturate and GABA-B mechanisms.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Membranous nephropathy produces immune-mediated podocyte injury with granular capillary-wall deposits on the epithelial side of the glomerular basement membrane, causing capillary-wall thickening and a spike-and-dome pattern; primary disease is often associated with podocyte-directed autoantibodies such as anti-PLA2R.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize membranous nephropathy from its nephrotic presentation and subepithelial immune-complex pattern.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Obstruction of hepatic venous outflow, usually by hepatic-vein thrombosis in a hypercoagulable state, causes sinusoidal congestion, painful hepatomegaly, ascites, and centrilobular hypoxic injury.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Budd-Chiari syndrome as hepatic venous outflow obstruction causing painful hepatomegaly and ascites.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Osteoid osteoma is a small benign bone-forming tumor with a vascular osteoid nidus and surrounding reactive sclerosis; high local prostaglandin production contributes to severe nocturnal pain that characteristically responds to NSAIDs.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize osteoid osteoma from its characteristic nocturnal NSAID-responsive pain and radiographic nidus.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Tissue transglutaminase 2 deamidates gliadin peptides, increasing their affinity for HLA-DQ2/DQ8 and thereby enhancing pathogenic CD4 T-cell activation in celiac disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain how tissue transglutaminase increases gliadin immunogenicity in celiac disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Acid entering the duodenum stimulates S cells to release secretin. Secretin activates Gs-coupled receptors on pancreatic ductal/centroacinar cells, increasing cAMP and secretion of bicarbonate-rich fluid.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify secretin as the principal hormonal stimulus for bicarbonate-rich pancreatic secretion after acid enters the duodenum.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Fatty acids and amino acids in the duodenum/jejunum stimulate I cells to release CCK, which contracts the gallbladder, relaxes the sphincter of Oddi, and stimulates pancreatic enzyme secretion.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify CCK as the hormone coordinating bile delivery and pancreatic enzyme secretion after a fat- and protein-rich meal.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Apical SGLT1 couples glucose or galactose uptake to the inward sodium gradient generated by basolateral Na+/K+ ATPase, making monosaccharide entry a secondary active transport process.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain intestinal glucose/galactose uptake as secondary active transport driven by the sodium gradient created by Na+/K+ ATPase.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Connexin-based gap junctions in intercalated discs form low-resistance channels that permit direct ion flow between adjacent cardiomyocytes, enabling rapid cell-to-cell propagation of depolarization.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate cardiac gap junctions to low-resistance intercellular electrical coupling and synchronized myocardial activation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: CDH1 inactivation causes loss of E-cadherin, reducing epithelial cell-cell adhesion and producing the characteristic discohesive single-file infiltration pattern of invasive lobular carcinoma.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect E-cadherin loss in invasive lobular carcinoma to defective epithelial cell-cell adhesion.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MHC class II molecules leave the ER associated with invariant chain. After invariant-chain degradation in endosomal compartments, CLIP remains in the peptide-binding groove until HLA-DM facilitates CLIP removal and loading of exogenous antigenic peptides.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify HLA-DM as the facilitator of CLIP removal and exogenous peptide loading onto MHC class II.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Newborns have an increased bilirubin load and reduced hepatic bilirubin-conjugating capacity because uridine diphosphate glucuronosyltransferase activity is relatively low after birth.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain physiologic neonatal jaundice by linking neonatal bilirubin metabolism to limited hepatic conjugating capacity.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Sotalol blocks the rapid delayed-rectifier potassium current, prolonging phase 3 repolarization and the QT interval; its reverse use dependence increases torsades risk at slower heart rates.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Relate sotalol-induced QT prolongation and torsades de pointes to blockade of the rapid delayed-rectifier potassium current.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Diamond-Blackfan anemia is a congenital pure red cell aplasia most often caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in ribosomal protein genes, producing defective ribosome biogenesis, p53-associated erythroid progenitor apoptosis, and selective erythroid failure.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Diamond-Blackfan anemia from early macrocytic reticulocytopenic anemia with selective erythroid aplasia and congenital anomalies, and relate it to defective ribosomal biogenesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MEN2B is caused by germline activating RET proto-oncogene mutations that increase receptor tyrosine kinase signaling; the M918T alteration accounts for most MEN2B cases.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize MEN2B and connect it to activating germline mutations of the RET receptor tyrosine kinase proto-oncogene.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Isoniazid metabolites interfere with vitamin B6 metabolism, reducing biologically active pyridoxal phosphate and predisposing to peripheral neuropathy; pyridoxine supplementation prevents or treats this toxicity.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect isoniazid-associated peripheral neuropathy with functional vitamin B6 deficiency and pyridoxine supplementation.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: EBV infects B lymphocytes and triggers a strong cellular immune response with activation of T lymphocytes; the atypical reactive lymphocytes in peripheral blood are activated T cells responding to infected B cells.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish EBV-infected B cells from the activated T lymphocytes that produce the characteristic atypical lymphocytosis of infectious mononucleosis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cyanide binds metal centers in mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase and halts oxidative phosphorylation, forcing anaerobic metabolism and causing severe lactic acidosis despite preserved oxygen delivery; failure of tissue oxygen extraction can produce unusually high venous oxygen saturation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain cyanide-induced histotoxic hypoxia by identifying inhibition of mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: When alveolar nitrogen is washed out by a very high inspired oxygen fraction, oxygen distal to a transiently closed or poorly ventilated airway is rapidly absorbed into pulmonary capillary blood; alveolar gas volume falls and the alveolus can collapse.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain why very high inspired oxygen promotes absorption atelectasis when ventilation to an alveolus is interrupted.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Partial verification bias occurs when receipt of the reference-standard test depends on the result of the index test, causing sensitivity and specificity estimates to be distorted because disease status is not verified comparably across index-test groups.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify partial verification bias when application of the reference standard depends on the index-test result.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Clinical decision-making capacity is decision-specific and requires the ability to understand relevant information, appreciate how it applies personally, reason about options and consequences, and communicate a choice.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Apply the core elements of decision-making capacity before accepting or overriding a patient's informed refusal.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Deoxygenated hemoglobin has greater capacity to carry carbon dioxide and buffer protons than oxygenated hemoglobin. In pulmonary capillaries, oxygen binding to hemoglobin decreases hemoglobin's affinity for carbon dioxide and promotes proton release; bicarbonate is thereby converted back to carbon dioxide for alveolar exhalation. This oxygen-dependent decrease in blood carbon-dioxide carrying capacity is the Haldane effect.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain the Haldane effect by linking hemoglobin oxygenation in pulmonary capillaries to reduced carbon-dioxide and proton binding and enhanced CO2 excretion.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: During sustained metabolic acidosis, proximal-tubule cells increase glutamine uptake and metabolism. Glutamine metabolism generates ammonium for urinary acid excretion and bicarbonate that is returned to the blood. Excretion of the generated ammonium therefore adds new bicarbonate to the body and is a major adaptive renal response to acid loading.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain renal compensation for sustained metabolic acidosis by identifying proximal-tubule glutamine metabolism as the source of increased urinary ammonium and new bicarbonate.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Pregnancy increases circulating thyroxine-binding globulin, largely through estrogen effects. The initial fall in free thyroid hormone stimulates increased thyroid hormone production until a new equilibrium is reached with normal free T4 and TSH but increased total T4 because more hormone is protein bound.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Interpret thyroid tests in pregnancy by recognizing the effect of increased TBG on total versus free thyroxine.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Biallelic GCDH pathogenic variants cause glutaryl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency, impairing degradation of lysine, hydroxylysine, and tryptophan. Glutaric acid and 3-hydroxyglutaric acid accumulate and are especially toxic to the striatum, predisposing young children to acute basal-ganglia injury and dystonia during catabolic illness.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize glutaric acidemia type 1 from its characteristic macrocephaly, illness-triggered striatal injury, dystonia, and organic-acid profile.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ABCC2 encodes the canalicular multidrug resistance-associated protein 2 (MRP2), which exports conjugated bilirubin and other organic anions from hepatocytes into bile. Loss of MRP2 causes benign isolated conjugated hyperbilirubinemia; pigment accumulation gives the liver a characteristic dark or black appearance.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect benign conjugated hyperbilirubinemia with a black liver to ABCC2/MRP2-mediated canalicular bilirubin export failure.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Cytochrome b5 reductase 3 uses reducing equivalents to return oxidized ferric heme iron (Fe3+) in methemoglobin to the ferrous (Fe2+) state that can bind oxygen. Autosomal recessive CYB5R3 deficiency restricted functionally to erythrocytes causes persistent methemoglobinemia and cyanosis, often with otherwise normal development in type I disease.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize recessive congenital methemoglobinemia and identify NADH-cytochrome b5 reductase (CYB5R3) as the key enzyme that maintains hemoglobin iron in the ferrous state.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: UMP synthase is a bifunctional enzyme that catalyzes the last two steps of de novo pyrimidine synthesis: conversion of orotate to orotidine monophosphate and then to UMP. Deficiency causes orotic acid accumulation and impaired pyrimidine availability, producing megaloblastic anemia that does not respond to folate or vitamin B12; unlike OTC deficiency, hyperammonemia is absent.
