construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish pituitary GnRH resistance from hypothalamic GnRH-neuron migration defects in normosmic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Dominant-negative THRA variants cause resistance to thyroid hormone alpha, producing hypothyroid features in TRα-predominant tissues such as bone and gastrointestinal tract with low-normal T4, high-normal T3, low T4/T3 ratio, and relatively preserved TSH feedback.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize resistance to thyroid hormone alpha from tissue-specific hypothyroid features with a low T4/T3 ratio and relatively normal TSH.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Biallelic TBX19 (TPIT) mutations impair terminal differentiation/function of pituitary POMC-expressing corticotrophs and are a major cause of neonatal-onset congenital isolated ACTH deficiency with preserved other pituitary axes.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate neonatal hypoglycemia with low ACTH/cortisol but preserved other pituitary hormones with biallelic TBX19/TPIT deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MAGED2 mutations cause X-linked transient antenatal Bartter syndrome with early severe polyhydramnios, prematurity, neonatal salt wasting/polyuria, and spontaneous resolution as renal tubular transporter expression/function matures after birth.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize MAGED2-associated transient antenatal Bartter syndrome from severe early polyhydramnios and neonatal salt wasting that spontaneously resolves.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC22A12 encodes apical proximal-tubule URAT1, a major urate reabsorptive transporter; loss causes renal hypouricemia with increased urate excretion and can predispose to exercise-induced acute kidney injury.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify URAT1/SLC22A12 as an apical proximal-tubule urate reabsorptive transporter and connect loss of function to renal hypouricemia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Heterozygous INF2 mutations can cause autosomal-dominant FSGS together with an intermediate Charcot-Marie-Tooth neuropathy by perturbing actin/cytoskeletal pathways important in podocytes and Schwann cells.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize INF2 disease when autosomal-dominant FSGS coexists with Charcot-Marie-Tooth neuropathy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Gain-of-function TRPC6 variants increase cation current and calcium entry in podocytes, perturbing calcium-dependent signaling and cytoskeletal homeostasis and causing autosomal-dominant FSGS.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect dominant TRPC6 gain-of-function variants to increased podocyte calcium entry and familial FSGS.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: LAMB2 encodes laminin beta2, a critical component of glomerular basement-membrane laminin; biallelic loss causes Pierson syndrome with congenital nephrotic syndrome/diffuse mesangial sclerosis and characteristic microcoria.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify laminin beta2 as the glomerular basement-membrane component defective in LAMB2-associated Pierson syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Under 45 CFR 46.408, when an IRB determines that children are capable of assent and has not waived assent, adequate provisions must be made to solicit that assent; parental permission is a separate protection and does not replace required child assent.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish parental permission from child assent in federally regulated pediatric research.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: FDA 21 CFR 50.24 permits a narrowly defined exception from informed consent for planned emergency research only with prospective regulatory safeguards, including IRB findings and community consultation/public disclosure, rather than ordinary clinical emergency privilege.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate the federal emergency-research exception from routine emergency clinical treatment and identify its prospective safeguards.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Under 45 CFR 46.304, an IRB carrying out responsibilities for HHS-regulated research involving prisoners must satisfy special composition safeguards: a majority of the Board, exclusive of prisoner members, must have no association with the involved prison apart from Board membership, and at least one member must be a prisoner or an appropriately experienced prisoner representative.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify the special IRB composition requirement for HHS-supported research involving prisoners under 45 CFR 46.304.
construct_inventory.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Gain-of-function LRP5 variants causing high bone mass impair normal antagonism of the Wnt coreceptor and increase canonical Wnt signaling and bone formation.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect LRP5 gain of function with increased canonical Wnt signaling and high bone mass.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Heterozygous ACAN variants can cause autosomal-dominant short stature with advanced bone age, premature growth cessation, and early osteoarthritis because aggrecan is a major extracellular-matrix proteoglycan of growth plate and articular cartilage.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize ACAN-related short stature when advanced bone age and early joint degeneration accompany an autosomal-dominant pattern.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Pseudoachondroplasia is caused by dominant COMP variants; mutant COMP misfolds and is retained in enlarged rough-ER cisternae of growth-plate chondrocytes, disrupting chondrocyte function and cartilage matrix assembly.
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link pseudoachondroplasia to intracellular retention of mutant COMP in growth-plate chondrocytes.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SERPINH1 encodes HSP47, an ER-resident collagen-specific chaperone that binds procollagen triple helices and supports proper folding/quality control; biallelic loss causes severe recessive osteogenesis imperfecta.

construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize transthyretin tetramer dissociation as the rate-limiting amyloidogenic step targeted by TTR stabilizers.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Disruption of the menin-KMT2A interaction that sustains a leukemogenic transcriptional program
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link menin inhibition to disruption of KMT2A-dependent leukemogenic transcription and restoration of differentiation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduced JAK-dependent STAT activation and nuclear translocation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect pan-JAK inhibition with impaired STAT phosphorylation and nuclear translocation downstream of cytokine receptors.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Dual-site extracellular HER2 binding that promotes receptor internalization and reduced surface HER2
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate dual-epitope HER2 antibody binding with receptor internalization from intracellular kinase inhibition, HER3 blockade, RNA interference, and decoy-receptor mechanisms.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Inhibition of BTK downstream of FcεRI signaling in mast cells and basophils
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect FcεRI-driven mast-cell degranulation with BTK signaling and recognize BTK inhibition as the direct action of remibrutinib.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Allosteric reversible inhibition of cardiac myosin motor activity
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate direct cardiac myosin inhibition from receptor- and calcium-channel-mediated negative inotropy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Bispecific engagement of BCMA on myeloma cells and CD3 on T cells
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize the BCMA×CD3 bispecific mechanism that redirects T cells against multiple myeloma cells.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Deutivacaftor potentiates the open probability of cell-surface CFTR while vanzacaftor and tezacaftor improve processing/trafficking
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish CFTR correctors that improve trafficking from a CFTR potentiator that increases channel open probability.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Selective SSTR2 agonism with suppression of cAMP, GH, and IGF-1 secretion
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link SSTR2 agonism to reduced cAMP signaling and suppression of GH/IGF-1 in acromegaly.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Oligonucleotide binding to the template region of telomerase RNA (hTR)
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize telomerase RNA-template binding as the direct molecular action of imetelstat.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Neutralization of TFPI Kunitz-2 activity, relieving inhibition of the extrinsic coagulation pathway
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link TFPI antagonism with enhanced factor Xa/FVIIa-tissue-factor activity and increased thrombin generation in hemophilia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reduction of 2-hydroxyglutarate produced by mutant IDH1/IDH2 enzymes
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Associate mutant IDH1/2 activity with production of 2-hydroxyglutarate and recognize reduction of this oncometabolite after IDH inhibition.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ERα antagonism coupled to proteasomal degradation of ERα protein
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize proteasomal ERα degradation as part of the direct cellular action of elacestrant.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: High-affinity C5 binding that blocks C5 cleavage and membrane attack complex formation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link C5 inhibition with prevention of membrane attack complex formation and reduced intravascular hemolysis in PNH.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Direct binding to HIV-1 capsid protein at the interface between capsid subunits
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize HIV-1 capsid as a direct antiviral target that affects multiple replication stages distinct from reverse transcriptase, integrase, entry, and protease mechanisms.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Inhibition of the influenza PA cap-dependent endonuclease required for cap-snatching
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate influenza cap-snatching inhibition by baloxavir from neuraminidase, M2, fusion, and polymerase-elongation mechanisms.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Antagonism of neurokinin-3 receptors involved in hypothalamic thermoregulation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize NK3-receptor antagonism as a nonhormonal mechanism for treatment of menopausal vasomotor symptoms.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Accumulation of 11-deoxycortisol after inhibition of CYP11B1 (11-beta-hydroxylase)
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link CYP11B1 inhibition to reduced cortisol synthesis and accumulation of its immediate precursor, 11-deoxycortisol.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: NPR-B activation with guanylyl cyclase activity and increased intracellular cGMP
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect CNP analog signaling through NPR-B with increased cGMP and antagonism of FGFR3-mediated growth inhibition in achondroplasia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Direct inhibition of ROS1 tyrosine kinase, including resistance-mutant ROS1
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Identify ROS1 as the direct oncogenic target of taletrectinib in ROS1-positive NSCLC, including disease with resistance mutations.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Increased hepatocyte-surface LDL-receptor recycling after PCSK9 mRNA degradation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect hepatocyte-targeted PCSK9 siRNA therapy with increased LDL-receptor recycling and increased plasma LDL clearance.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Pharmacological chaperoning of amenable mutant alpha-galactosidase A
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize pharmacological chaperoning as stabilization of an amenable misfolded enzyme to restore intracellular trafficking and function.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Antagonism of the C5a receptor on neutrophils
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate C5a-receptor antagonism from upstream complement blockade and direct C5 inhibition.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Blockade of HIF-2alpha heterodimerization with HIF-1beta
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link VHL loss to HIF-2alpha stabilization and recognize HIF-2alpha/HIF-1beta heterodimerization as the direct target of belzutifan.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Antisense binding to prekallikrein mRNA with RNase H1-mediated degradation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate antisense-mediated reduction of prekallikrein synthesis from enzyme inhibition, bradykinin neutralization, receptor antagonism, and gene editing.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Ex vivo expansion and reinfusion of autologous tumor-derived T cells
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish tumor-derived autologous T-cell expansion from other cellular immunotherapy platforms.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: TCR recognition of MAGE-A4 peptide presented by compatible HLA class I
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use peptide-MHC restriction to explain why a MAGE-A4-specific engineered TCR therapy requires a compatible HLA-A*02 allele.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MMAE-mediated disruption of the microtubule network after c-Met-directed internalization
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect vedotin/MMAE antibody-drug conjugates with intracellular microtubule disruption after target-mediated internalization.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Direct binding to mitochondrial cardiolipin
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize cardiolipin as an inner-mitochondrial-membrane target and distinguish direct membrane-lipid binding from respiratory-enzyme targets.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Dual inhibition of PDE3 and PDE4 with accumulation of intracellular cyclic nucleotides
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize dual PDE3/PDE4 inhibition as a mechanism that raises intracellular cyclic nucleotides in COPD therapy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: CRF1 receptor antagonism in the pituitary with reduced ACTH secretion
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link pituitary CRF1 antagonism with reduced ACTH drive and reduced adrenal androgen production in classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Gamma-secretase inhibition that blocks proteolytic activation of the Notch receptor
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize gamma-secretase-dependent proteolytic activation as a druggable step in Notch signaling.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Positive allosteric modulation of GABA-A receptors
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize neuroactive-steroid positive allosteric modulation of GABA-A receptors as the direct pharmacologic action of zuranolone.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PI3K-delta inhibition with reduced PIP3 production and downstream Akt signaling
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link PI3K-delta inhibition with reduced PIP3 generation and decreased Akt/mTOR pathway activity in activated PI3K-delta syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Agonism of central melanocortin-4 receptors regulating hunger, satiety, and energy expenditure
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate therapeutic MC4-receptor agonism from off-target melanocortin effects and other central appetite pathways.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Local inhibition of apical intestinal NHE3 with reduced sodium absorption
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link intestinal NHE3 inhibition to reduced sodium absorption, increased luminal water, and accelerated transit.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Agonism of the aryl hydrocarbon receptor
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize AhR agonism as a distinct topical anti-inflammatory pharmacologic mechanism.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Monoclonal antibody binding to IL-36 receptor with blockade of IL-36 signaling
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate IL-36 receptor blockade from other cytokine-targeted biologic mechanisms used in inflammatory skin disease.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Restoration of molybdenum-cofactor-dependent sulfite oxidase activity
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect cPMP replacement in MOCS1 deficiency with restoration of molybdenum cofactor and sulfite oxidase function.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Binding to the glucocorticoid receptor
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize glucocorticoid-receptor signaling as the direct pharmacologic action of vamorolone while separating it from the genetic defect in DMD.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Allosteric activation of red-cell pyruvate kinase
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect allosteric pyruvate-kinase activation with increased RBC ATP production and improved survival in pyruvate kinase deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Activation of the Nrf2 oxidative-stress response pathway
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Nrf2 activation as the pharmacologic pathway associated with omaveloxolone in Friedreich ataxia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Farnesyltransferase inhibition preventing progerin farnesylation and membrane accumulation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize protein farnesylation as the druggable processing step responsible for abnormal progerin accumulation in Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Binding to the neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn), reducing IgG recycling
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect FcRn blockade with accelerated IgG catabolism and reduced pathogenic autoantibody levels.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reversible inhibition of the ileal bile acid transporter, reducing enterohepatic bile acid reabsorption
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link IBAT inhibition in the terminal ileum with reduced enterohepatic bile acid recycling and lower circulating bile acids.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Neutralization of ANGPTL3 with LDL-receptor-independent enhancement of lipoprotein processing
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize ANGPTL3 inhibition as an LDL-receptor-independent lipid-lowering mechanism.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Hepatic expression of a B-domain-deleted human factor VIII transgene
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect AAV5 liver-directed gene transfer in hemophilia A with expression of a B-domain-deleted factor VIII transgene.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Adenoviral transduction of bladder urothelium with transient local IFN-alfa 2b expression
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate local adenoviral transgene expression from replicating viral therapy, systemic cytokine delivery, and genome editing.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reversible potassium-competitive inhibition of the gastric proton pump
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate potassium-competitive acid blockade from covalent proton-pump inhibition, H2 blockade, and antacid therapy.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Allosteric inhibition by binding the TYK2 regulatory domain
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish regulatory-domain allosteric TYK2 inhibition from catalytic-site JAK inhibition and downstream STAT blockade.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PPAR-linked FGF21-dependent downregulation of CYP7A1 and reduced bile acid synthesis
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link PPAR/FGF21 signaling with CYP7A1 downregulation and reduced hepatic bile acid synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Dual antagonism of endothelin type A and angiotensin II type 1 receptors
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize combined ETA and AT1 receptor antagonism as the defining dual mechanism of sparsentan.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Reversible inhibition of complement Factor D in the alternative pathway
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate proximal Factor D inhibition from direct C3, Factor B, properdin, and C5 blockade in complement biology.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Calcineurin inhibition prevents NFAT dephosphorylation and activation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link calcineurin inhibition with reduced NFAT activation and decreased T-cell cytokine transcription.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: CYP27A1 loss causing mitochondrial sterol 27-hydroxylase deficiency with reduced bile-acid synthesis and cholestanol accumulation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis as CYP27A1-dependent mitochondrial sterol 27-hydroxylase deficiency that impairs bile-acid synthesis and causes cholestanol accumulation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Temsavir binding to HIV-1 gp120, preventing attachment to CD4
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate gp120 attachment inhibition from fusion inhibition, coreceptor blockade, integrase inhibition, and reverse-transcriptase inhibition.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: RNA-interference-mediated degradation of hepatic ALAS1 mRNA
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link givosiran RNA interference with selective hepatic ALAS1 mRNA degradation and reduced ALA/PBG production.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Dual antagonism of orexin OX1R and OX2R
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize dual orexin-receptor antagonism as a non-GABAergic pharmacologic approach to insomnia.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Blockade of the vWF A1-domain interaction with platelets
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect vWF A1-domain blockade with reduced platelet adhesion and consumption in acquired TTP.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Failure of the ETF-ETFDH electron-transfer pathway shared by multiple flavoprotein dehydrogenases
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Explain why defects in ETFA, ETFB, or ETFDH cause multiple acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency by interrupting electron transfer from several flavoprotein dehydrogenases to ubiquinone.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Riboflavin transporter loss reduces intracellular riboflavin available for conversion to FMN and FAD
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect SLC52A2/SLC52A3 riboflavin-transporter deficiency to reduced FMN/FAD availability and impaired mitochondrial oxidation-reduction reactions.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Mannose phosphate isomerase deficiency impairs interconversion of fructose-6-phosphate and mannose-6-phosphate
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate MPI-CDG from PMM2-CDG by identifying the fructose-6-phosphate ↔ mannose-6-phosphate reaction and understanding why oral mannose can bypass MPI deficiency.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Apolipoprotein C-II is an essential cofactor that activates lipoprotein lipase
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish APOC2 deficiency from LPL, GPIHBP1, and remnant-clearance disorders by recognizing apoC-II as a required activator of lipoprotein lipase.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Alpha-2-antiplasmin restrains fibrinolysis by directly inhibiting plasmin
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate alpha-2-antiplasmin from PAI-1 and coagulation-factor mechanisms by recognizing alpha-2-antiplasmin as the plasma inhibitor assayed through neutralization of excess plasmin.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Molybdenum cofactor deficiency simultaneously reduces activity of sulfite oxidase and xanthine oxidase
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use the combined sulfur-metabolite and purine pattern to identify loss of a shared molybdenum cofactor rather than an isolated sulfite- or purine-pathway enzyme defect.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: DOCK8-dependent CDC42-PAK control of lymphocyte shape integrity during migration through confined three-dimensional tissues
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Connect DOCK8 loss to failure of CDC42-PAK-dependent coordination of cytoskeletal structures, causing lymphocyte elongation and cytothripsis during migration through confined tissues.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: GAMT-catalyzed methylation of guanidinoacetate to creatine
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Use elevated guanidinoacetate plus cerebral creatine deficiency to localize the block to the GAMT-catalyzed methylation step of creatine synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC6A8-mediated sodium- and chloride-dependent creatine transport into brain and muscle
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish SLC6A8 creatine transporter deficiency from AGAT and GAMT biosynthetic defects by recognizing impaired cellular creatine uptake despite intact synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Adenylosuccinate lyase catalysis of two nonsequential purine-biosynthesis reactions that each release fumarate
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize adenylosuccinate lyase deficiency from succinylpurine accumulation and identify its two nonsequential fumarate-releasing reactions in de novo purine synthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MAGT1 is an accessory component of the STT3B oligosaccharyltransferase machinery; its loss causes selective N-linked glycosylation defects, including hypoglycosylation and reduced expression of NKG2D
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize MAGT1 deficiency as a selective N-linked glycosylation disorder in which NKG2D hypoglycosylation reduces NKG2D expression and compromises cytotoxic lymphocyte function.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Citrin is the mitochondrial aspartate-glutamate carrier that exports aspartate to the cytosol while importing glutamate plus a proton
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link SLC25A13/citrin deficiency to loss of mitochondrial aspartate export, impaired malate-aspartate shuttling, and reduced cytosolic aspartate availability for the urea cycle.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ALDH7A1 deficiency causes P6C accumulation, which chemically condenses with and inactivates pyridoxal 5-prime-phosphate
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize pyridoxine-dependent epilepsy due to ALDH7A1 deficiency as a lysine-catabolism disorder in which accumulated P6C chemically inactivates PLP.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC46A1 encodes the proton-coupled folate transporter required for intestinal folate absorption and for folate transport into cerebrospinal fluid
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Distinguish hereditary folate malabsorption from isolated cerebral folate disorders by recognizing that SLC46A1/PCFT is required for both proximal-intestinal folate absorption and transport of folate into cerebrospinal fluid.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: Mitochondrial carbonic anhydrase VA generates bicarbonate that is supplied to CPS1 and multiple mitochondrial carboxylases
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize CA5A deficiency as impaired mitochondrial bicarbonate generation, simultaneously compromising CPS1 and several biotin-dependent carboxylases.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC19A2 encodes the high-affinity thiamine transporter THTR1; loss reduces cellular thiamine uptake
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize thiamine-responsive megaloblastic anemia syndrome as loss of SLC19A2/THTR1-mediated high-affinity cellular thiamine transport.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ETHE1 is a mitochondrial sulfur dioxygenase; its loss causes sulfide accumulation that inhibits cytochrome c oxidase
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link ETHE1 deficiency to impaired mitochondrial sulfide detoxification and secondary inhibition of cytochrome c oxidase by accumulated hydrogen sulfide.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC39A8 deficiency causes manganese deficiency, reducing activity of manganese-dependent Golgi beta-1,4-galactosyltransferase
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize SLC39A8 deficiency as impaired cellular manganese uptake that causes secondary dysfunction of manganese-dependent glycosyltransferases, especially Golgi beta-1,4-galactosyltransferase.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: AGK is a kinase-independent subunit of the TIM22 complex required for import and assembly of mitochondrial carrier proteins
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize Sengers syndrome due to AGK deficiency as a mitochondrial carrier-import disorder caused by disruption of the TIM22 complex, independent of AGK lipid-kinase activity.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PANK2 is a pantothenate kinase that phosphorylates pantothenate at the entry step of coenzyme A biosynthesis
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link PANK2-associated neurodegeneration to loss of pantothenate kinase activity, which normally catalyzes ATP-dependent phosphorylation of vitamin B5 in coenzyme A biosynthesis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: LIPT1 is required for transfer of lipoic acid to selected 2-ketoacid dehydrogenase proteins, allowing their lipoylation and activation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize LIPT1 deficiency as a selective mitochondrial lipoate-transfer defect that reduces lipoylation and activity of 2-ketoacid dehydrogenase complexes.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: RAB27A is required for regulated cytotoxic-granule secretion; RAB27A-deficient lytic granules polarize toward the immunologic synapse but fail to dock efficiently at the plasma membrane
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Differentiate defects within the cytotoxic-granule pathway: RAB27A deficiency impairs docking and regulated exocytosis of polarized lytic granules, causing Griscelli syndrome type 2 with HLH susceptibility.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PGM3 activity is required for synthesis of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine, a donor substrate used by multiple N-linked and O-linked glycosylation pathways
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize PGM3 immunodeficiency as a hexosamine-pathway defect that lowers UDP-GlcNAc availability and thereby compromises multiple protein-glycosylation pathways.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: LRPPRC forms an RNA-binding complex that stabilizes mitochondrial mRNAs and supports their polyadenylation and coordinated translation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize LRPPRC deficiency as a post-transcriptional mitochondrial gene-expression defect involving mRNA stabilization, polyadenylation, and coordinated translation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC30A10 is a cell-surface manganese efflux transporter; loss of trafficking or efflux function causes cellular and systemic manganese accumulation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize SLC30A10-associated hypermanganesemia as failure of cell-surface manganese efflux rather than a defect in copper, iron, or manganese-uptake pathways.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: SLC25A3 is the mitochondrial phosphate carrier that imports inorganic phosphate into the matrix for oxidative phosphorylation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize SLC25A3 deficiency as impaired mitochondrial inorganic-phosphate import, limiting oxidative ATP synthesis despite preserved respiratory-chain complex activities.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: PNKP is a bifunctional DNA-end processing enzyme with 5-prime kinase and 3-prime phosphatase activities
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link PNKP-associated microcephaly and seizures to defective DNA strand-break end processing caused by loss of 5-prime kinase and 3-prime phosphatase activities.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: ATP13A2 is a lysosomal polyamine exporter with high affinity for spermine
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize ATP13A2-associated neurodegeneration as a lysosomal transport disorder in which defective polyamine, especially spermine, export disrupts lysosomal homeostasis.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: DDHD2 functions as a major intracellular triglyceride hydrolase in the central nervous system; loss promotes neuronal lipid-droplet accumulation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Recognize DDHD2-associated SPG54 as a neuronal lipid-metabolism disorder in which reduced intracellular triglyceride hydrolysis causes ectopic lipid-droplet accumulation.

construct_inventory.tested_construct: MTFMT formylates mitochondrial Met-tRNA to generate fMet-tRNA required for efficient mitochondrial translation initiation
construct_inventory.educational_objective: Link MTFMT-associated Leigh syndrome to defective formylation of mitochondrial methionyl-tRNA and impaired mitochondrial translation initiation.

duplicate_analysis.near_duplicate_threshold: token-set Jaccard on vignette + lead-in + A-E options + tested_construct

verdict_note: Read-only audit of stored canonical content and metadata. This verifies structural/evidence/source-metadata compliance and lexical duplicate risk; it does not independently re-adjudicate every medical claim against live external sources.
